articleTitle: Intelligent Content Summarization System Using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This project proposes an NLP-based Intelligent information Summarization System that reduces the effort required for comprehending and summarizing instructional material, maximizing engineering students’ study time. By using state-of-the-art natural language processing (NLP) techniques, the system allows students to efficiently extract relevant information from online videos, thereby transforming the learning experience. By automating the material summary, it both demonstrates the revolutionary potential of natural language processing (NLP) in education and helps students feel less stressed. This project fosters academic success by allowing students to engage more fully with the course materials. It also symbolizes a paradigm shift toward more efficient and accessible education. The approach may promote academic success and advancement for students.

articleTitle: A Wireless Intrusion Detection System using Feature Selection with Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Wireless networks have become integral to modern communication infrastructure, facilitating seamless connectivity in various domains. However, their presence everywhere also makes them vulnerable to various attacks. Those can cause failure in network services. Indeed, a robust Wireless Intrusion Detection System (WIDS) is essential for identifying and mitigating attacks on wireless networks. The key objective of WIDS is to detect wireless traffic and classify it as an attack or normal. In this situation, machine learning (ML) algorithms are used to detect attacks or intrusions in wireless systems. However, these algorithms need to accurately detect attacks early. Feature selection (FS) techniques are used to reduce this detection time and increase accuracy. These allow our system to identify attacks against local nodes. The proposed system is implemented, experimented and tested on AWID3 dataset. The performance of the system is determined by using a random forest (RF) algorithm and FS selection techniques. The experimentation conducted on AWID3 shows that the proposed methodology achieved an accuracy of 99.9990% for the binary model using 143 significant features and an accuracy of 99.9985% for multilabel classification using 144 significant features

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of Face Recognition Advancements
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Face recognition technology has experienced significant advancements in recent years due to the rapid progress in deep learning techniques. The purpose of this comprehensive literature review is to examine the various applications and underlying methodologies of face recognition. With recent advancements in face recognition techniques, a wider range of scenarios and challenges can be addressed. In this survey, we explore the latest developments in face recognition, including pitch variations, lighting changes, occlusions, and varied environments. The survey provides a comprehensive review of face recognition technology, covering applications, methodologies, dataset usage, model accuracy, and workings. Additionally, it analyzes three main approaches to face recognition for static images: traditional (or classical), deep learning-based, and hybrid. Hence, providing an overview of and comparing some of the popular face recognition approaches and techniques is the main objective of this paper.

articleTitle: Key Safe Algorithms for Blockchain Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the fast-changing world of blockchain tech, keeping cryptographic algorithms secure and efficient is crucial, especially for managing keys in groups. This paper compares three cryptographic algorithms—Shamir's Secret Sharing Scheme, Blakley's Scheme, and the Asmuth-Bloom Scheme—to see how well they work in managing group keys in blockchain systems. We look at how fast they are and how well they resist attacks to understand their strengths and weaknesses in blockchain. Key management is really important for keeping things secure with cryptography, especially in systems like distributed ledgers. We study how long it takes to use Shamir's Secret Sharing, Blakley's Scheme, and the Asmuth-Bloom Scheme in blockchain, showing how efficient and scalable they are, which matters a lot in big distributed systems. We also look at how secure these cryptographic schemes are against different types of attacks, like trying lots of passwords, intercepting messages, working together to attack, and finding vulnerabilities in the system. By focusing on both efficiency and security, we try to get a clear picture of which cryptographic scheme is best for blockchain, especially when managing group keys securely and dynamically. In our research, we found that in terms of speed, Shamir's Secret Sharing Scheme outperforms the Asmuth-Bloom Scheme and Blakley's Scheme, with Shamir being the fastest, followed by Asmuth and then Blakley. However, regarding security, all three schemes demonstrate robustness against various attack vectors. We also discovered that Shamir Secret Sharing Scheme’s efficiency could be further enhanced by implementing Newton's interpolation technique for value interpolation.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis and Automation of Dental Treatment Outcomes: A Multi-Faceted Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of various object identification models for dental diagnostics using Orthopantomograms (OPGs). A custom dataset was created specifically for dental image analysis, and the performance of several contemporary models was compared, including YOLOv5, YOLOv8, and multiple models built on the Detectron2 framework.Our findings reveal trade-offs between different models in terms of computing efficiency, false negative rate, total loss, and classification accuracy. These trade-offs are crucial considerations for researchers when selecting a model for a specific application in dental diagnostics. Notably, Faster R-CNN R50 FPN 3x achieved a balance between classification accuracy and data processing speed, while Mask R-CNN R50 DCS 3x demonstrated superior foreground classification accuracy despite a higher overall loss. Additionally, RPN R50 C4 emerged as the model with the fastest processing time. These results highlight the importance of tailoring model selection to the specific requirements of dental diagnostic tasks.This study is significant because it examines the success rate of advanced deep learning models in dental diagnostics, it could result in automated and precise detection of dental issues, benefiting patient care and minimizing manual workload for dental practitioners.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Speech Synthesis for Enhancing the Learning Ability of Individuals with Dyslexia
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper explores dyslexia recognition and expressive speech synthesis. Dyslexia, a neurological disorder, impairs reading and writing but not intelligence. Early diagnosis using machine learning is crucial. Reviewing 19 articles, the paper addresses challenges in data collection, preprocessing, and model evaluation for dyslexia prediction. It also examines the shift from conventional to deep learning models in speech synthesis, focusing on generating expressive, human-like speech. Additionally, the paper proposes using generative neural networks to produce audio of basic Hindi words to aid dyslexic children. This work provides insights and directions for future research in both dyslexia recognition and expressive speech synthesis.

articleTitle: VoiceEye: A Communication Aid Between a Voiceless and Sightless
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: VoiceEye is a vital tool for communication for many individuals who are hard of hearing or deaf. The Deaf people speaks sign languages as their native tongues, which are helpful for communication ability. Sign languages are used by a variety of people, including those who can hear but cannot speak, even though they are mostly used by deaf people. When speaking in situations when it is physically impossible to speak, such underwater, through glass, from a distance, at a loud music performance, or while having your mouth full, VoiceEye can be employed. Additionally, you can converse with someone using sign languages without disturbing others with loud noises. While at the movie theater, you can talk to your pal about how much you detest the film without bothering anyone else. The concept behind the VoiceEye is that if there are two people, one which is visually impaired and one which is deaf, if they want to communicate with each other how will they do? The VoiceEye becomes a bridge for these people. The system contains two modules, namely Sign-To-Voice and Voice-To-Sign. The Sign-To-Voice module helps the deaf person to communicate using his sign language gestures with the visually impaired person. In Voice-To-Sign module, the visually impaired person can simply speak what is want to communicate with deaf person. In this way the project will help a lot of visually disabled and deaf persons to solve their communication problem and raise a confident within them for their socializing. The proposed work has achieved the overall accuracy of 98% in recognizing and voicing the individual alphabets. Our work includes as of three words for which 100% accuracy is achieved.

articleTitle: Network Based Control Systems for Six Axis Robot System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Principal network traffic in network-based control systems (NBCS) is driven by plant Sensor–Controller–Actuator nodes operating in closed-loop. The performance provided by an NBCS's quality-of-control (QoC), and Every closed-loop operation is dependent on both the message scheduling method and the controller design.In this paper, We discuss the problem of NBCS afterwards we describe the token ring scheduling algorithm solution ,sampling algorithm calculation and the simulation results.

articleTitle: Semantic Embedding-Based Recommender System for Research Paper Discovery and Subject Area Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative approach to research paper recommendation and subject area prediction, leveraging advanced natural language processing techniques. The research encompasses two primary sections: large-scale classification for subject area prediction using a shallow Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) model and research paper recommendation powered by a Sentence Transformer model. Through meticulous data cleaning and preprocessing, including tokenization and text vectorization, the research ensures high-quality embeddings that capture the semantic meaning and context of each research paper. The MLP model facilitates accurate prediction of subject areas based on paper titles and abstracts, while the Sentence Transformer model generates rich semantic embeddings for research papers. The system architecture involves training these models on a dataset of research paper abstracts and titles, achieving impressive performance metrics such as a categorical accuracy of 99.46% on the test set. The implementation of a user-friendly interface using Streamlit enhances accessibility, allowing users to input queries and receive personalized recommendations along with detailed paper categories. This transformative research not only advances the field of research paper recommendation but also contributes to the development of intelligent systems for knowledge discovery and academic research.

articleTitle: MedyEth: Blockchain Based Electronic Heatlhcare Records System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In an era where global healthcare coverage stands at 50%, the need for accessible, secure, and efficient healthcare services is paramount. Electronic Health Records (HER) play a pivotal role in this, digitizing patients’ health information to improve care quality and communication among providers. However, challenges such as interoperability, data security, and usability hinder their full potential. To address these, we proposed a blockchain-based HER system integrated with an AI-chatbot. Blockchain ensures secure, tamper-proof data storage and seamless data sharing, while the AI-chatbot enhances patient engagement and provides personalized medical advice.

articleTitle: Identification of Tumor using Segmentation & Object Detection: A Comparison and an Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Abnormal cells proliferate in the brain to form brain tumors, which frequently cause death. Localising and segmenting brain tumors using MRI is a difficult task in medical analysis, yet it is necessary for many applications. Accurate segmentation of brain tumor images is required for the identification and treatment of patients with these tumors. Even though they achieved promising segmentation results on the BRATS 2020 dataset, several of them need more testing and training time due to their complicated structure. In order to help doctors identify tumors in their early stages with high accuracy, we have proposed a two-step deep learning method for the diagnosis of three different types of tumors: necrotic, edema, enhancing, as well as brains free of tumors, using MRI images. The metrics used for evaluating the performance of these models are intersection over union, recall, and precision. The research indicates the precision of YOLO model to be 0.97 showcasing the accurate tumor detections, while recall and IoU of UNet segmentation to be 0.99 and 0.83 respectively. In this study, we addressed the issue of inaccuracy and latency in current artificial diagnosis systems by proposing a robust method for classifying brain tumors using deep learning techniques.

articleTitle: Exploring Recent Advances in Sentiment Analysis, Research Methodologies, and Technical Approaches for the Study of Bank Nifty Index
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Sentiment analysis has emerged as a pivotal technique in deciphering investor sentiment and market trends, thereby influencing investment decisions in financial markets. This paper delves into the recent strides made in sentiment analysis, research methodologies, and technical approaches specifically tailored for studying the Bank Nifty Index, a key benchmark in the Indian financial landscape. By integrating sentiment analysis with traditional financial analysis techniques, researchers and practitioners stand to glean deeper insights into market dynamics and make more astute investment choices. This paper encompasses recent developments in sentiment analysis, research methodologies and technical approaches, scrutinizes their applicability to the Bank Nifty Index, and elucidates their implications for financial research and practice.

articleTitle: Enhancing Navigation Systems: A Comprehensive Survey with Proposed Innovations for Improved User Experience
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This review research looks at recent advancements in intelligent travel route selection, cooperative vehicle infrastructure systems, and dynamic real-time navigation. It investigates the integration of cutting-edge technologies including the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), Inertial Navigation System (INS), vehicular communication, and recommendation systems in order to revolutionise road navigation, speed up route planning, and enhance safety protocols. This paper comprehensively analyses the corpus of existing literature and technological breakthroughs to highlight important challenges and suggest potential future directions. It highlights the importance of user-centered design principles and suggests avenues for future innovation in contemporary transportation systems.

articleTitle: Voice Auth: Audio Verification with Deep-Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Today, AI has been helping us in every aspect, from our phones to driving cars on itself. However, AI can also prove to be a boon to cybercriminals as they also evolve their attack techniques. Using AI to generate fake audio, unrecognizable from the real one has been prevailing to deceive the current voice authentication system. It also becomes difficult to perform audio forensics on these files and might go unnoticed. The given system manipulates the various audio features extracted from the audio such as spectrogram, chromagram, and Mel-spectrum, etc. And differentiate between the real one and the deep-faked voice. This review paper discusses the two for the detection of fake audio. The extracted feature is visualized by converting it into a PNG. Employing CNN to differentiate between the real and deep-faked voice and adjusting the +network appropriately gives the best results. The system efficiently reduces the effort of audio forensics and gives accurate results. RVC-based cloning can be detected using various audio features. The system can also be used for voice authentication where deep fake voices can deceive the existing system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Wheelchair Design: Integrating Gesture Recognition, Health Tracking and Fall Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Individuals facing physical disabilities encounter various challenges that significantly impact their daily lives. These disabilities may result from accidents, congenital conditions, or progressive diseases, leading to limitations in mobility, sensory perception, or dexterity. Tasks that others may take for granted, such as walking, using stairs, or even simple movements, can become arduous or impossible for those with physical disabilities. This paper presents the design and implementation of an intelligent wheelchair system that integrates gesture recognition, fall detection, and health monitoring functionalities. The system is developed to enhance the mobility and well-being of individuals with physical disabilities, providing them with greater autonomy and safety. Gesture recognition technology allows users to control the wheelchair’s movement and functions using intuitive head gestures, enabling effortless navigation and operation. Fall detection algorithms continuously monitor the user’s movements and promptly alert caregivers or emergency services in the event of a fall, ensuring timely assistance and intervention. Furthermore, the health monitoring system tracks vital signs and health parameters in real time, providing users and healthcare providers with valuable insights into their well-being. By combining these advanced technologies into a single platform, the intelligent wheelchair offers a comprehensive solution to support individuals with physical disabilities, promoting independence, safety, and improved quality of life.

articleTitle: Detection of Neurodegenerative Disorder
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Globally, neurodegenerative diseases like dementia and Alzheimer's represent a major danger to our healthcare system. Clinical evaluations, which may or may not be able to identify the modest cognitive changes that occur in the early stages of the disease, have historically played a major role in diagnosis procedures. Recent developments in machine learning technologies have demonstrated potential paths for enhancing diagnostic precision and have demonstrated that they are more than capable of identifying these illnesses. Thus, we employed CNN, SVM, and logistic regression to identify dementia in an image dataset.

articleTitle: Smart Helmet with User Navigation Guidance Support
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research presents a Smart Helmet that directs user navigation to improve safety and convenience. The desire for novel approaches to improve safety and convenience is critical in an increasingly interconnected world. This work proposes an innovative design for a Smart Helmet that includes user navigation guidance. The fundamental goal of this system is to provide users with real-time navigation support while ensuring their safety via modern technology. The Smart Helmet has been equipped with numerous sensors such as GPS and lidar sensors, enabling accurate tracking of the user's motions and orientation. This data is processed when integrated into a microcontroller unit, resulting in precise navigation instructions. The navigation guidance assistance system functions. The core features of the Smart Helmet include a Global Positioning System (GPS) module for accurate location tracking and a navigation system that overlays route information onto the Display. Users can receive turn-by-turn directions and other relevant information without diverting attention from the road. The helmet-mounted camera serves as a computer vision algorithm that can be implemented to enhance safety features, such as obstacle detection and collision warnings. Safety is paramount. The helmet is constructed with impact-resistant materials to meet safety standards and regulations. Theoretically, this can be done by giving users visual and aural cues through a heads-up display (HUD) built into the helmet's visor. To guarantee safety throughout the trip, the system also continually monitors user input and the surrounding environment. Furthermore, the Smart Helmet includes safety elements to ensure the user's well-being during the ride.

articleTitle: Frame Acceleration and Super Resolution for video Enhancement Using GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Low-resolution (LR) videos are common in various applications, including surveillance and video conferencing, primarily due to bandwidth constraints or older recording technologies. This research introduces a novel approach for enhancing the quality of LR videos by leveraging Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) equipped with MeanShift loss, perceptual loss, Total Variation (TV) Loss, and a modified VGG19 architecture. By processing each frame of an LR video through our model, we achieve significant improvements in visual quality, detail sharpness, and temporal consistency, resulting in high-resolution (HR) videos that are both visually pleasing and realistic. The conventional approach to video enhancement, particularly when employing deep learning models like GANs, involves processing high volumes of data, which can be computationally intensive and time-consuming. This challenge is compounded in real-time applications or environments lacking powerful graphical processing units (GPUs). Our research proposes a novel solution by extracting frames from low-resolution (LR) videos, enhancing each frame individually, and then recombining them into a high-resolution (HR) video. This method offers a significant reduction in computational requirements, making high-quality video enhancement accessible on less capable hardware and suitable for real-time processing.

articleTitle: YOLOv8 vs. Mask R-CNN: A Comparative Analysis of for Glomeruli Instance Segmentation in Kidney Tissues
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Wildfires Accurate and timely analysis of glomeruli is paramount in deciphering kidney diseases and guiding treatment strategies. However, traditional manual segmentation methods are laborious, susceptible to inter-observer variability, and impede real-time diagnosis. This research delves into the realm of deep learning, investigating the efficacy of two prominent models, YOLOv8 and Mask R-CNN, for automated glomeruli instance segmentation in kidney images. Our comprehensive study meticulously compares the performance of both models, meticulously evaluating metrics like precision, recall, and mAP50. The results paint a compelling picture, with YOLOv8 emerging as the champion. It exhibits superior precision (0.97 versus 0.85 for Mask R-CNN), recall (0.85 versus 0.78), and mAP50 (0.93 versus 0.85), demonstrating its prowess in accurately delineating glomeruli. Furthermore, YOLOv8 shines in terms of computational efficiency, boasting significantly faster inference times (3.3 ms versus 7.5 ms for Mask R-CNN). This lightning-fast performance renders it exceptionally suitable for real-time applications, enabling rapid diagnoses and prompt interventions in critical situations. The findings of this investigation unveil YOLOv8's immense potential as a robust and efficient tool for automated glomeruli segmentation. Its remarkable accuracy, coupled with real-time processing capabilities, paves the way for a paradigm shift in kidney disease diagnostics.

articleTitle: Preserving Speaker Identity in Speech-to-Speech Translation: An Exploration of Attention-Based Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Effective speech-to-speech translation (STST) requires not only accurate linguistic conversion but also preservation of the speaker's unique vocal identity. The paper research investigates the efficacy of attention-based encoder-decoder architectures in achieving this goal. The impact of incorporating speaker embeddings through various attention mechanisms is explored, including speaker-aware self-attention, cross-attention with speaker embeddings, and a dedicated speaker attention module within the decoder. Utilizing the CVSS multilingual dataset. The approach is rigorously evaluated through objective metrics (BLEU, WER, speaker recognition accuracy, cosine similarity, FID) and subjective human perception studies. The results demonstrates that dedicated speaker attention and cross-attention mechanisms within the decoder significantly enhance speaker identity preservation without compromising translation accuracy. These results pave the way for the development of STST systems that deliver both accurate content and natural, personalized communication experiences.

articleTitle: Exploring the Adoption of Human Resource Analytics by Human Resource Professionals of the EdTech Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The researchers have developed a technology adoption model to gauge the adoption intention of Human Resource Analytics (HRA) by the HR professionals belonging to the EdTech sector to carry out various HR functions. The proposed theoretical model has captured the impact of Performance Expectancy (PET), Effort Expectancy (EET), Social Influence (SIF), Facilitating Conditions (FCT), Trialability (TRB) on Behavorial Intention (BHI) of HRA Adoption. Moderating impact of Gender and Experience on the above-mentioned factors have also been validated by using SPSS and AMOS.Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology extension model (UTAUT 2) has validated the primary responses collected from employees of EdTech sector operating in Bangalore region (n=223). The results arrived at by using Structural Equation Model (SEM) analysis suggest that there exists a significant positive relationship between EET and BHI, SIF and BHI, PET and BHI. The moderation results denote that gender moderates the relationship between SIF and BHI and that experience moderates the relationship between EET and BHI & SIF and BHI. This study will facilitate the EdTech sector to arrive at informed decisions pertaining to their human resource and prepare customized strategies for implementing HRA.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Captioning through the Integration of Image Processing and NLP
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The study offers a novel method for captioning images by combining Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). A feature extractor called VGG19 can be used to take complex photos and extract high-level visual representations from them. The aforementioned visual inputs are subsequently fed into a language model that employs a GRU and Bi-directional LSTM, two widely recognised models for handling sequential dependencies, to produce captions that make sense and are contextually relevant. Selective information update is made possible by the GRU’s gating mechanism, making it simpler to capture long-range dependencies in the output captions. The combination of VGG19, GRU, and Bi-directional LSTM provides a comprehensive and hierarchical method for photo captioning that extracts rich visual information required for comprehending complex picture content. GRU’s gating technique makes it easier to analyse specific information, which improves the model’s comprehension of complex relationships found in output captions. In order to provide more accurate image descriptions, the suggested methodology seeks to improve the synergy between visual and verbal knowledge. Comparing experimental assessments against modern technique approaches on benchmark datasets with metrics like BiLingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU), METEOR, and CIDEr shows encouraging results. In addition to its potential uses in computer vision(CV), accessibility, and human-computer interaction, this work advances the field of image caption development.

articleTitle: Empowering Yoga Practice Through Pose Detection and Pose Accuracy Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This study introduces a method for evaluating yoga poses using pose detection technology to support self-learning. Leveraging the capabilities of pose detection technology, specifically the Mediapipe library in Python, the system accurately identifies and tracks key body landmarks in real-time. These landmarks serve as input features for Multinomial Logistic Regression, a statistical technique well-suited for modelling categorical outcomes such as different yoga poses. By utilizing Multinomial Logistic Regression on the coordinates of body landmarks, the system can effectively classify and assess the correctness of yoga postures. Moreover, the introduction of measurable metrics for pose accuracy allows for the development of interactive yoga games aimed at engaging youth and fostering enthusiasm. These metrics, derived from the probabilistic outputs of the logistic regression model, provide quantitative feedback on pose correctness, thereby facilitating self-assessment and motivating continued practice. Through the integration of pose detection technology and Multinomial Logistic Regression, this framework offers a promising solution for enhancing the effectiveness of yoga training and increasing engagement among practitioners.

articleTitle: A Study of Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan: an Initiative to Enrich Digital Education in Rural Area of Jalgaon District Maharashtra
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The digitization of education stands as an indispensable instrument for nations dedicated to the attainment of education that is both of high quality and inclusively accessible. This research delves into the critical assessment of the efficacy of digital initiatives seamlessly integrated into the "Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan," a universal scheme unveiled by the Government of India and the Ministry of Human Resource Development on May 24, 2018. Focusing on the Jalgaon district in Maharashtra, the study meticulously scrutinizes the execution and outcomes of this pioneering initiative, offering insights into the challenges encountered and the level of cognizance among educators concerning digitalization. Employing a framework of descriptive analysis, data were meticulously amassed from 50 educators in secondary and senior secondary government schools spanning across five blocks in Jalgaon. The revelations emanating from the study affirm the commendable progress achieved by the Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan in realising its digitalization objectives within the district. Nonetheless, the research discerns several impediments, including subpar internet connectivity, inadequacies in teaching materials, a dearth of technical support for educators, and deficiencies in the physical infrastructure of classrooms, encompassing limited dimensions and insufficient furnishings. In the face of these challenges, the study accentuates the pivotal role undertaken by the Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan in augmenting digital education in the region. The research culminates with the presentation of a cogent framework, proposing strategies to mitigate the identified constraints and further enhance the implementation of this groundbreaking initiative.

articleTitle: Improving Crowdfunding Integrity with Blockchain using Ethereum-based smart contract
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Blockchain, as we have seen, was first only a foundation for cryptocurrencies, but ten years later, a new rapidly growing technology has been widely used in multiple businesses. In a more significant number of years, most of the technologies in Blockchain can be used worldwide to authoritatively enhance online transactions. Crowdfunding is one of the integrating disciplines for blockchain technologies. Today, people worldwide are experiencing the most common problem with crowdfunding i.e. the lack of regulation over the campaigns-people get scammed. Many other projects also took an incredibly long time to finish.This project aims to address these problems by preventing fraud and ensuring that projects may be finished within the allocated time by integrating Ethereum smart contracts in crowdfunding.

articleTitle: Mindful Meadows: A Mental Health App
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper presents 'Mindful Meadows,' a Flutter-based mobile application designed as an all-inclusive platform for mental health support and wellness. The app uniquely combines various mental health functionalities into a singular, user-friendly interface, eliminating the need for multiple disparate applications. It addresses the diverse needs of individuals seeking mental well-being support. Firstly, it offers specialized tests for different mental conditions, aiding users in self-assessment and awareness. These tests are complemented by a history tracking feature for monitoring mental health progress over time. Another significant component is the inclusion of a serene and soothing music library, curated to promote relaxation and stress relief. Additionally, the app introduces a mental yoga section, providing guided practices aimed at enhancing mental resilience and mindfulness. For community support and interaction, "Mindful Meadows" incorporates a community chat feature, enabling users to connect with others experiencing similar mental health challenges. The app also integrates a responsive chatbot for immediate assistance and guidance. In its commitment to comprehensive care, "Mindful Meadows" offers a unique feature for consulting with therapists. This includes a seamless appointment booking system, facilitating easy access to professional help. Overall, "Mindful Meadow" emerges as a pioneering solution in mental health technology, intertwining professional care, community support, and cutting-edge technology to promote optimal mental wellness.

articleTitle: Noise Removal for Mammogram Images Using Gaussian based Unsharp Masking
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: One major health issue that still affects women is breast cancer, and timely detection of breast masses dramatically improves life expectancy. (CAD)Computer-Aided Diagnosis help radiologists in achieving precise and accurate diagnoses, with mammograms being a key tool for early detection. However, noise in mammogram images can mislead diagnoses, making image preprocessing essential to remove noise while preserving critical information. Traditional noise reduction algorithms often deteriorate edge details, leading to false predictions and inappropriate treatments. In order to reduce noise effectively without sacrificing important information, this paper presents a cascade technique that combines unsharp masking with a Gaussian filter. The effectiveness of the suggested approach was evaluated against commonly used denoising filters such as Gaussian, Mean, Median, and Conservative Smoothing filters. Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Mean Squared Error (MSE) on mammograms from the MIAS (Mammographic Image Analysis Society), InBreast, and DDSM (Digital Database for Screening Mammography) datasets were used to assess the effectiveness of the suggested approach. The suggested method showed considerable gains in noise reduction. It achieved PSNR values of 45.48 dB, 45.10 dB, and 50.26 dB, and corresponding MSE values of 1.64 dB, 0.37 dB, and 0.66 dB for the InBreast, MIAS, and DDSM datasets, respectively. Additionally, the impact of noise reduction on classification accuracy was examined using gradient boosting, SVM, and random forest classifiers. The analysis revealed a notable improvement in accuracy, with an average increase of 6.06% when using noise-free mammogram images. This enhanced accuracy indicates that removing noise from mammograms contributes to clearer and more reliable feature representation, enabling machine learning models to make more accurate predictions.

articleTitle: Develop a Framework of a recurring Procedure for Improving Agro Production and Plant Quality by using frameworks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This study seems to propose an innovative approach to addressing the complexities of agricultural sustainability and productivity. By integrating graph-based Q-learning into two crucial aspects of agriculture—nutrient management and crop quality prediction—it offers a promising solution to optimize resource usage and enhance crop yield and quality. The utilization of Q-learning, a reinforcement learning technique, in constructing Nutrient Action and Quality-Action Graphs is particularly intriguing. These graphs seem to serve as dynamic frameworks for decision-making, allowing the algorithm to adapt and learn optimal strategies based on environmental conditions and crop requirements. The emphasis on tailoring nutrient management strategies to special crop and soil textures while taking environmental conditional factors like temperature and humidity underscores the importance of precision agriculture. This approach has the potential to revolutionize traditional fertilization and plant management practices by offering more tailored and adaptive solutions. Overall, combining of these models into agro decision-making processes holds promise for improving both productivity and sustainability in the face of fluctuating environmental conditions and increasing food demand.

articleTitle: Clustering-Based Intrusion Detection System for High Volume and High Velocity Packet Streams
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Any intrusion detection system's efficacy is determined by how quickly it can identify fresh threats and stop subsequent assaults. This requires employing highly efficient machine learning techniques, including clustering algorithms that can distinguish between normal and abnormal network data. This research proposes an IDS based on machine learning utilizing clustering, marking an initial step in this direction. By comparing various clustering techniques using network packet traces, the authors provide data for evaluating these algorithms. The article also outlines a work-in-progress IDS suitable for environments with high traffic volumes, blurred enterprise boundaries, and a high risk of malicious attacks.

articleTitle: Sign Language Translation with fusion of Emotion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Sign languages play a crucial role in fostering natural interaction, breaking down communication barriers between the hearing impaired and society. However, recognizing words in sign language poses significant challenges, particularly when gestures for multiple words are similar. Additionally, the rapid transition between gestures during communication complicates the creation of coherent sentences based on recognized words. To address these challenges, we propose the Real-Time Sign Language Recognition and Emotion Detection (RTSLRED) model, leveraging MediaPipe’s holistic pipeline and LSTM network. Specifically focusing on American Sign Language (ASL), our model aims to enhance accessibility and inclusivity for the hearing-impaired community. Our results indicate an impressive accuracy of 91.05%, showcasing the model’s effectiveness in conveying emotions and sentences in sign language. This innovation holds promise for empowering the hearing impaired and promoting inclusive communication practices.

Author Keywords: RTSLRED (Real-Time Sign Language Recognition and Emotion Detection)

articleTitle: Medi Connect-Website for Small Clinic Doctors for Reaching Out to New Patients in need: Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Medi-Connect revolutionizes the healthcare landscape with its cutting-edge online platform, dedicated to simplifying and enhancing the medical appointment booking experience. Our user-centric website provides a seamless and efficient solution for patients seeking to connect with healthcare professionals. Boasting an extensive database encompassing a myriad of doctors and healthcare facilities, our platform empowers patients to effortlessly identify and schedule appointments with providers tailored to their unique needs and preferences. At the core of our mission is the commitment to streamline the appointment booking process, ensuring a user-friendly interface that significantly reduces the time and effort traditionally associated with healthcare scheduling. This not only makes healthcare more accessible and hassle-free for patients but also serves as a strategic tool for doctors, empowering them to effectively manage their schedules and optimize patient care. Medi-Connect stands as a beacon of innovation, fostering a new era of efficiency and accessibility in the realm of healthcare, where seamless connections between patients and doctors pave the way for an improved and optimized healthcare experience.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Framework for Video Resolution Enhancement: using Computer Vision and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The paper introduces a computer vision based four-phase framework for enhancing video resolution by removing motion blur and motion based temporal aliasing. Beginning with stabilization using the Lucas-Kanade method, a stable foundation is created. Subsequent stages involve deblurring through Gaussian blurring and Wiener deblurring, addressing temporal aliasing with bicubic interpolation. To further boost resolution a final denoising stage using Non-Local Means method reduces noise while preserving details in a video. To overcome the limitations of computer vision based model we have designed a deep learning approach with the U-Net architecture employed for large motion frame interpolation. U-Net enhances spatial features and even uses Super Resolution Convolutional Neural Network (SRCNN) for deblurring of video and making the video more sharper. This innovative methodology aims to redefine video resolution, with potential applications in surveillance, video analytics and content creation.

articleTitle: Generation and Detection of Artificial Facial Images
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning, and deep learning have revolutionized various real-world applications. This paper presents a technique to generate artificial facial images and proposes deep-learning approaches to distinguish between real and artificial facial images. The objective is to develop an effective method for discerning genuine faces from manipulated ones. The proposed models utilize a dataset comprising both real and artificial images and employ neural networks-based deep learning algorithms. Social media platforms have become predominant sources of information, yet not all shared content is genuine; photographs can be altered, leading to deepfakes as a significant threat for spreading misinformation. Therefore, there is an urgent need to develop models capable of detecting deepfakes. This paper introduces a deepfake detection framework utilizing convolutional neural networks and the publicly available 140K Real and Fake Faces dataset to accurately identify deepfakes in images.

articleTitle: Deepfake Detection Using Deep Learning: ResNext and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Deep fake technology has been advancing at a rapid pace, and it has become increasingly difficult to distinguish between real and fake videos. Deep fake technology can be used to manipulate and create convincing fake videos that can spread misinformation, propaganda, and even be used for blackmail. As a result, there is a growing need for reliable and accurate deep fake detection techniques to combat this threat. The solution proposed is a deep learning-based approach for deep fake detection. Deep learning models can learn to identify patterns and features in videos that can be used to distinguish between real and fake videos. The proposed system is highlighting the integration of ResNext 50 and LSTM. By exploiting the potential of pretrained models to acquire hierarchical features and combining them with sequential feature extractor such as LSTM detection systems can acquire great precision in differentiating manipulated content from real world. These different ways together contribute to the ongoing work in detecting deep fakes, underlining the need of adopting varied methodologies to successfully prevent the propagation of modified synthetic media.

articleTitle: Creating an Experimental Setup in Mininet for Traffic Flow Collection During DDoS Attack
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The proliferation of network-enabled devices and the increasing reliance on digital services have underscored the importance of effective network monitoring and security measures. DDoS attacks continue to pose significant threats to network availability and performance, targeting critical infrastructure and disrupting business operations. This research paper presents a detailed methodology for constructing an experimental setup using Mininet to simulate and collect traffic flow data during Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks. The paper outlines the steps involved in setting up the network environment, configuring traffic generation, launching DDoS attacks, and collecting traffic flow data for analysis. The proposed setup provides researchers with a controlled environment to study DDoS attack behaviors and evaluate mitigation strategies.

articleTitle: Forecasting Diabetes: Leveraging ML for Early Detection and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Diabetes is one of the increasing chronic diseases that must be treated well as soon as it is detected. In today's world, diabetes is the most occurring disease. Diabetes is mainly of two types: Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes. The majority of the population is affected by Type 2 diabetes. Over the period, Type 2 Diabetes causes severe damage. Similarly, Type 1 can also cause serious damage, but its prevention is not known yet. So, modern technologies like machine learning would be helpful in predicting diabetes status. In the conventional healthcare system, the diagnosis of this disease primarily depends upon the test reports and the doctor's experience. It may not be accurate every time. Machine learning is a method of classifying different instances by utilizing the knowledge gained using historical data. In this work, the diabetes patient dataset available in the Kaggle repository is used. Different preprocessing methods are used for data cleansing efficiently. This cleaned data can be used for model training. After applying all classification algorithms, the three machine learning algorithms models, such as Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), and KNN, are combined to form a hybrid classifier using stacking-based ensemble learning. The proposed system has shown the classification accuracy of 97.57%.

articleTitle: Safe and Secure Online Item Bidding using DAPP
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Electronic communication is expanding quickly right now, and many new applications are following suit. This aided numerous enterprises in turning a profit in their corresponding industries. Online item bidding has become a popular method for buying and selling goods in the digital age. Online item bidding traces its roots back to the early days of the internet when platforms like eBay revolutionized the way people buy and sell goods. Over the years, online item bidding has evolved to include various platforms and technologies, making it a convenient and accessible way for individuals and businesses to engage in commerce. E-Auction System is one of the numerous electronic communication applications that is now receiving a lot of positive feedback from users. An efficient E-Commerce system that enables online communication between a party offering to buy an asset and a party who sells through E-Auction System. The many restrictions of traditional auctions, such as physical location, timing and travel, a finite number of participants, etc., have been greatly reduced by this online format. BlockChain and smart contracts can be used as a ground-breaking technology in our auction system that has caught the interest of numerous sectors. The security of payment gateways is very strong. Our model's objective is to enable everyone to organise their own auctions or participate in the auction from any location on Earth. We must adapt ourselves in accordance with the changes in technology.

articleTitle: Resume Parsing and Skill Extraction using Custom Pattern Matching algorithm and Gemini API
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the realm of contemporary recruitment, efficient resume parsing is essential for talent acquisition. This paper investigates resume parsing using advanced OCR technology and NLP methods. We begin with preprocessing, enhancing scanned resumes for legibility. Leveraging the Tesseract OCR engine, we convert images to machine-readable text. Through NLP techniques with spaCy, we extract key information like personal details, education, experience, and skills.Our approach integrates the Gemini Pro Vision API for semantic analysis and question-answering. This enriches our framework, enabling deeper insights and implicit attribute inference. Empirical validation across diverse datasets demonstrates the robustness of our methodology. This work sheds light on performance metrics and challenges in automated resume parsing, paving the way for future enhancements.

articleTitle: Enhancing Agriculture: Implementing Web Application for Agriculture Solutions from Experts
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Imagine a world where farmers have instant access to the collective wisdom of agricultural experts, right at their fingertips. This abstract delves into the transformative potential of web applications in enhancing agriculture, bringing expert knowledge and innovative solutions directly to those working the land. By leveraging web applications, farmers can tap into a wealth of expertise, ranging from crop management techniques to pest control strategies, without the limitations of geographical distance or time constraints. These web applications serve as virtual hubs, where farmers can pose questions, seek advice, and collaborate with experts and fellow farmers alike. Through interactive forums, live chat support, and multimedia resources, farmers gain access to tailored solutions that address their specific needs and challenges. Whether it's diagnosing crop diseases or optimizing irrigation practices, the collective wisdom of agricultural experts is just a click away. With features such as weather forecasts, market analysis, and agronomic alerts, farmers can make data-driven decisions that maximize productivity and minimize risk. By fostering collaboration and knowledge-sharing among farmers, researchers, and extension agents, these applications spark innovation and drive continuous improvement in agricultural practices.

articleTitle: DigiPramaan: Blockchain Based Certificate Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: With more people taking online courses and earning certifications, there are great new opportunities to improve skills. But, this digital trend has also led to a problem with fake certificates. To address this problem, we propose a robust certificate management system utilizing blockchain technology and smart contracts. Our system comprises three key components: certificate creation, authenticity verification, and a user-friendly digital storage solution. Blockchain technology is at the core of our system, ensuring that each certificate is immutable and trustworthy. We utilize cryptographic hashes as unique identifiers for each certificate, which detect any tampering by resulting in a different hash. Additionally, our system offers secure digital storage based on cloud technology, allowing users to efficiently manage and access their certificates. We also emphasize features for certificate revocation and updates, enhancing the system’s security and adaptability. In conclusion, our blockchain based system offers a comprehensive and secure solution to the issue of fake certificates in the digital era.

articleTitle: Visionary AI: Transforming Diabetic Retinopathy Discovery through Advanced Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Leveraging AI for DR detection can transform patient outcomes by enabling early intervention and preventing vision loss. Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a significant contributor to visual impairment and blindness globally. It predominantly affects patients who have lived with diabetes for an extended duration. The work aims to develop an effective representation for retinal images, enhancing the recognition. This paper discusses the implementation of a transfer learning-based method for DR discovery with a deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) using Inception-v3, VGG-16, Alexnet, Googlenet and ResNet 18 architecture on the APTOS 2019 Dataset and metrics like the precession, confusion matrix, f1- score and recall evaluated. In summary, these studies underscore the transformative potential of deep learning in revolutionizing the judgement of DR.

articleTitle: Smart Procurement and Contract Management Solution Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper investigates the integration of blockchain technology into e-procurement, assessing its advantages and challenges. A framework is introduced, encompassing smart contracts, digital identity verification, and consensus mechanisms tailored for procurement needs. Through case studies, blockchain’s transformative impact on trust, fraud prevention, and procurement efficiency is demonstrated. Additionally, the transition to blockchain based e-tendering is explored, promising enhanced transparency, decentralization, and security in procurement processes. The framework not only facilitates cost reduction but also enhances public trust, emphasizing the socio-economic benefits of blockchain adoption in procurement

articleTitle: Harnessing Deep Learning for Lung Cancer Early Detection through AI-Enabled Chest CT Imaging Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Lung illnesses comprise a spectrum of ailments that affect the ability to breathe with lung cancer standing as a significant contributor to global mortality rates. Timely detection substantially improves survival prospects, with average survival rates increasing from 14 to 49 percent when diagnosed early. While CT (Computerised Tomography) is more efficient than traditional Radiography, comprehensivediagnosis often involves employing multiple imaging modalities to complement one another. Deep neural networks have been developed recently and assessed in terms of using CT scans to identify lung tumors. CT images of the chest are increasingly pivotal in diagnosing and managing lung cancer clinically. Artificial intelligence (AI) holds promise in swiftly assessing CTscans to differentiate cancerous findings from other clinical conditions. Scan results from emergency room, oncology, and pneumonia cases are included in normal control scans. Among 140 patients with laboratory- confirmed pneumonia unrelated tomalignancy, the false positive rate was 10%.AI-driven algorithms demonstrate the capability to identify CT scans indicative of lung cancer-associated pneumonia and to distinguish this pneumonia with high specificity across various patient demographics. Lung cancer, although not contagious, can have fatal consequences when affecting the lungs. A proposed technique for detecting lung infections aims to discern whether an individual is afflicted with cancer and assess the extent of infection, facilitating early intervention to potentially save lives.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Constraints in Automated Character Recognition from Ancient Modi Manuscripts
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Ancient documents still contain a lot of information which helps to resolve today’s problem, but due to lack of right preserving methods such documents are at the edge of degradation. In Maharashtra, Modi is an ancient scripting language used for documentation since the 17th century and the style of scripting changes with time. Modi-script also a part of cursive style, written on a paper without lifting pen. The primary objective of this study is to examine the various approaches utilized in HOCR, with a particular focus on the Modi scripts.

articleTitle: Fabric Defect Detection Using YOLO V8
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Textile quality assurance during processing is accomplished through fabric defect detection which is among the most important processes. The conventional manual inspection techniques are time consuming and subjective, resulting to inefficiency in quality flow. In recent years, the capability of computer vision and deep learning techniques to automate defect detection jobs has been proven. This paper puts forward a new technique in fabric defect detection using YOLO V8 which is a dominant object detection network. YOLO V8 presents an upgrade of performance and energy efficiency compared to the previous ones, therefore, the improved YOLO V8 version becomes more appropriate for defect detection in textiles. The experimental data confirms the validity of the proposed method in successfully identifying different fabric kinds of defects. Thus, it is a scalable and efficient option for checking quality in textile manufacturing.

articleTitle: Summarizing Surveillance Videos through Automatic Human Activity Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In today’s world, ensuring the safety of individuals relies heavily on video surveillance encompassing activity monitoring, recording, and event detection. However, this surveillance approach introduces challenges such as continuous 24 × 7 monitoring, substantial storage requirements, and the manual identification of objects or events of interest within recorded video sequences. This paper addresses these practical issues by presenting a video summarization and automatic person identification technique based on deep learning. The objective is to generate concise video summaries from surveillance footage that are shorter than the original video length and contain relevant keyframes featuring both moving and still persons. The proposed technique integrates the YOLOv5m and DeepSORT frameworks for detecting and tracking human beings, facilitating the creation of these short video summaries. Experimental evaluations are conducted on the VIRAT and TVSum video datasets, and the hybrid approach is validated using real-life video recordings from institutional premises and public spaces. The results indicate that the proposed method automatically and effectively detects persons under varying lighting conditions, thereby producing informative summary videos.

articleTitle: Adoption of AI in CRM in the Retail Sector. A perspective from Technology Acceptance Model
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The researchers have used the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM3) to measure the adoption intention of AI in the retail sector. The paper aims to capture the factors that influence the adoption intention of AI in customer relation management in the retail sector. The primary data comprising of 487 respondents was validated by TAM3 which was further analyzed by SEM. The findings of the result revealed that motivation does not impact the perceived ease of use (PEU). Automation and self-efficacy significantly influenced PEU while accuracy, social influence, and customer experience positively impacted PUF (perceived usefulness). Both PEU and PUF significantly impacted the adoption intention of AI in the retail sector. The study will help retail service providers and CRM software developers gain better insight into the adoption of AI

articleTitle: Early Detection of Cognitive Skill Impairments using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Cognitive skills are essential for everyday tasks, encompassing mental abilities such as memory, problem-solving, and logical thinking. Conditions such as depression, anxiety, and schizophrenia can impair these skills, affecting memory, attention, and problem-solving abilities. The COVID pandemic and other stress-inducing events have a great impact on individuals, often leading to stress-related diseases. Depression often stems from heightened stress levels, yet individuals may struggle to recognize or seek help due to social stigma. Delayed treatment impairs outcomes. Surveys indicate low success rates in treating cognitive skill impairment. Early identification through routine cognitive testing is crucial, especially for vulnerable individuals due to age, family history, or health conditions. Regular screenings facilitate proactive healthcare management, leading to improved outcomes in patients with cognitive skill impairments. This study explores the application of Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithms for the early detection of cognitive skill impairments, aiming to develop accurate prediction models for identifying individuals at risk of cognitive decline. By employing feature selection methods, the SVM achieved an 83% accuracy rate. This study aimed to advance the development of efficient cognitive assessment tools, enabling early intervention and personalized care for individuals vulnerable to cognitive impairment.

articleTitle: Attendance System using Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID) Technology and Cloud-Based Services in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Monitoring student attendance is crucial for academic institutions to ensure students' active participation and compliance with academic requirements. This paper addresses the need for improved attendance management by proposing an integrated and automated system. The goal is to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of student attendance recording in higher education using RFID technology, Microsoft Power Platforms, and Microsoft SharePoint Lists for data storage. Survey results indicate a strong preference among respondents for a more automated and efficient attendance system, such as one based on RFID. In conclusion, implementing an integrated and automated attendance management system using RFID technology, Microsoft Power Apps, and Power Automate is expected to significantly improve the efficiency, accuracy, and usability of student attendance processes in higher education.

articleTitle: Sign Language Detection for Deaf and Hard of Hearing (DHH) Community
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Deaf and hearing communities face communication barriers that this paper addresses with a novel, real-time sign language recognition system with integrated sentence generation. The system leverages You Only Look Once version 8 (YOLOv8) for efficient hand sign detection within video streams, achieving an impressive accuracy of 96%. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) acts as a powerful decoder, deciphering the meaning behind the signs. This research goes beyond recognition by employing advanced techniques to translate the recognized signs into grammatically correct sentences, enabling a more natural flow of communication. The effectiveness of the system is rigorously evaluated, demonstrating its potential to revolutionize communication accessibility and inclusivity for sign language users. This groundbreaking technology, with its ability to generate sentences from signs, has the potential to break down barriers and foster a more connected world for all

articleTitle: Enhanced Healthcare Monitoring and Medication Reminders for Elderly Individuals Using Wearable Sensors and Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Better healthcare monitoring systems catered to the unique requirements of senior citizens are becoming more and more necessary as the world’s population ages. We describe a new initiative to address this need, which aims to create a system for medication reminders and enhanced healthcare monitoring using wearable sensors and a smartphone application. To continually monitor important physiological parameters, the system makes use of contemporary MCU technology coupled with blood pressure and temperature sensors. The technology identifies abnormalities and notifies carers or healthcare providers, allowing for prompt actions, through sophisticated data analysis. In addition, the mobile application offers real-time access to health data and prescription reminders, making it an easy-to-use interface for senior citizens and the carers who look after them. This project promotes proactive health management, lowers healthcare expenditures, and provides a holistic solution to enhance healthcare outcomes and quality of life for senior citizens.

articleTitle: Analysis Of The Best Creational Design Patterns In Software Development
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In a world where efficiency and reusability are the bread and butter of software development, we often find ourselves in a loop seeking better implementations of software design patterns. We as humans try to make our lives easier by reusing existing frameworks and ideologies to save time and achieve efficiency in our work.We often hear the saying "Why reinvent the wheel" whenever we try to find solutions to problems that have already been solved. Design patterns are just software design principles and ideologies that we can follow to avoid reinventing the wheel and make our software more structurally robust and efficient. Many design Patterns have been made, all of which play different roles in different parts of software design.This paper aims to offer a comprehensive overview of all five creational design patterns, including advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Segmentation and Classification of Breast Ultrasound Images
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Breast cancer remains a major public health concern, requiring better diagnostic technologies for early identification and treatment. In this research, we leverage the Breast Ultrasound Image dataset (BUSI) to construct a comprehensive approach to breast cancer detection employing deep learning methodologies. We employ the U-Net architecture for segmentation, training the model on ultrasound images along with their corresponding masked images to automatically delineate tumor regions. Additionally, we explore classification using state-of-the-art models, including EfficientNetV2-S, ResNeXt-101 (64*4d), and MaxVit, initially utilizing solely ultrasound images. Subsequently, we enhance classification accuracy by overlaying the segmented masked images onto the ultrasound images, augmenting the feature representation for classification. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of integrating segmentation and classification approaches, yielding improved accuracy in breast cancer detection compared to standalone classification methods. In the diagnosis of breast cancer, this combined strategy has the potential to enhance clinical decision-making and patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Laptop Bargains Unleashed: Exploring the Influence of Price Comparison Websites
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Purchasing a laptop can be difficult during days of endless online shopping options and wide price fluctuations. This paper suggests the solution of creating a specific website to make laptop price comparison easier. The website collects real-time pricing data for a variety of laptop models from major retailers by utilizing web scraping techniques. This allows customers to spend as little money as possible when buying a laptop. In order to, help users find the best offers available online, the website provides standard price comparison. By offering a platform that simplifies the entire buying process and lowers the uncertainty involved in obtaining a new laptop. The paper also discusses future development directions such as improving data accuracy guaranteeing best-in-class display on multiple devices and putting user experience first via continuous feedback integration. By addressing these areas for improvement, the proposed website has the potential to grow into a useful resource for buyers looking to make informed laptop purchases. It will also be able to stay relevant in the constantly changing field of web data extraction and analysis, helping users to successfully navigate the challenges of online laptop shopping.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Stock Price Prediction using Time Series Models
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The inconsistency of the stock market is ungovernable, making it prone to imminent financial risks. Our research indicates that the system displays remarkable precision in producing prognostics based on historical data derived from Yahoo Finance in the form of graphs and values. Resorting to our model, financial analysts and investors can alleviate risk and capitalize on market opportunities, facilitating informed decision-making. Our study’s primary focus is evaluating the following four models for predicting stock market prices: Long Short-Term Memory, Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average, Seasonal Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average using eXogenous factors, and Auto-Regressive Moving Average. ARIMA utilizes differencing to stabilize non-stationary time series, while ARMA amalgamates autoregressive and moving average components to record linear dependencies. SARIMAX strengthens ARIMA by integrating seasonal fluctuations, suitable for modeling seasonal trends in financial data. Deep learning techniques like LSTM excel at recognising complex temporal correlations. These findings showcase the importance of utilizing advanced forecasting techniques to navigate the ever-changing financial landscape, offering valuable insights for professional and academic purposes.

articleTitle: Interactive Sign Language Learning Platform Fostering Sign Language Literacy
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Sign language is an important means of communication for deaf people, but limited resources may hinder the development of their rehabilitation skills. This study demonstrates an effective method for learning sign language that can lead to success. We created an interactive platform built in React with patterns designed to recognize letters, numbers, and emotions. The system seamlessly integrates media pipe models for real-time gesture recognition, allowing users to quickly receive instructions. Our research aims to improve accessibility and inclusion by providing effective educational tools for language acquisition. Our research aims to close the communication gap between hearing-impaired people, strengthen relationships, and enable communication and socialization by integrating new technology and learning objectives.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Learning of Computer Internal Systems Through Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The rapid advancements in technology have opened new avenues for educational methodologies, particularly in the domain of computer science. This paper explores the potential of Augmented Reality (AR) as an innovative tool to enhance the understanding of computer internal systems. AR, by overlaying digital information onto the physical world, provides an interactive and immersive learning experience that can make complex concepts more accessible and engaging. Through the implementation of AR applications, students can visualize and interact with 3D models of computer components, such as CPUs, memory modules, and storage devices, in real-time. The study involves a development of conceptual model for AR application covering a computer internal component, assessing its impact on student engagement through user preferences identification and challenges, and thus exploring the broader potential of AR in technical education. The results indicate that AR may significantly improve comprehension, retention, and engagement, providing a promising supplement to conventional computer science education. By integrating AR into the curriculum, educators can offer a more dynamic and interactive learning environment, fostering deeper understanding and enthusiasm for the subject.

articleTitle: Advanced Water Quality Assessment through Integrated Machine Learning models for Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Water, the basic necessity of any living organisms, constitutes a fundamental human right yet remains tragically inaccessible and unsafe for millions. With nearly 2.5 million annual deaths attributed to waterborne diseases, ensuring access to pollution-free water transcends mere necessity, becoming a potent catalyst for improved global health. Freshwater scarcity is a global problem that is being exacerbated by overexploitation of freshwater sources and climate change impacts. This research delves into machine learning algorithms for analyzing and classifying safe water quality. This research study conducts a comparative analysis of water quality classification models utilizing a series of machine learning algorithms. A series of data preprocessing steps were implemented on this dataset with a view to construct a generic model. This set of steps includes balancing of data using the balancing algorithm and the feature selection. Out of all these applied learning techniques, Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost with hyper parameter (HP) tuning provides the highest accuracy equal to 94.62% and 95.39%.

articleTitle: Automated Waste Management System: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In response to the growing challenges of waste management, particularly in urban areas, this study presents an innovative approach leveraging deep learning techniques for automated waste management. Traditional waste management systems often struggle with inefficiencies in waste sorting and processing, leading to environmental pollution and resource wastage.
