SVM-1-x and SVM-2-x model accuracy are evaluated and compared. The comparative analysis shows that the performance of SVR-2-x models with an additional input factor, namely particulate matter, outperforms the SVR-1-x model. The percentage improvement in the SVM-2-4 model for different metrics is 15.26% for MAE, 27.87% for MSE, 14.57% RMSE and 2.63% for R2. The inclusion of PM2.5 and PM10 with other meteorological parameters such has relative humidity, minimum and maximum temperature provide more comprehensive representation of the atmospheric condition thereby enhancing the predictive capabilities of the SVR model for global solar radiation prediction.

articleTitle: Soft Tissue Tumor Detection Using U-Net
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Soft tissue tumor detection is vital for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning in clinical practice. In this manuscript, we present a fresh perspective for soft tissue tumor detection using the U-Net architecture, a powerful convolutional neural network (CNN) model widely employed in medical image segmentation tasks. Our method leverages the inherent capabilities of U-Net for precise delineation of soft tissue tumors from medical images. We augment the U-Net model with advanced techniques such as region growing and confidence-connected thresholding to enhance segmentation accuracy. Through comprehensive experimentation on diverse datasets, we demonstrate the efficacy of our approach in accurately detecting soft tissue tumors across various modalities and imaging conditions. Comparative analysis with existing methods underscores the superiority of our proposed method in terms of both accuracy and computational efficiency. Moreover, we discuss the practical implications and potential applications of our approach in clinical settings, highlighting its utility for assisting medical professionals in accurate tumor detection and treatment planning. Overall, our proposed method represents a significant advancement in soft tissue tumor detection, offering a reliable and efficient solution for clinical diagnosis and management.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) involves identifying and analyzing emotions conveyed through speech signals. It utilizes techniques from machine learning and signal processing to extract features from audio data, enabling the classification of emotions such as happiness, sadness, anger, fear, disgust, and neutrality. SER has applications in human-computer interaction, virtual assistants, mental health monitoring, and sentiment analysis. The paper employs two distinct models for speech emotion recognition. The first model utilizes Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, starting with data preprocessing via Librosa, including resampling and feature extraction such as MFCCs. Following dataset splitting, the LSTM architecture, optimized for sequential data, incorporates input layers, multiple LSTM layers, and dense layers with suitable activation functions. Model training involves monitoring progress using validation set metrics. The second model explores real-time emotion recognition using live audio input, employing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and LSTM Networks. Data preprocessing, feature extraction, and selection are executed before model training. The findings contribute to advancing speech-emotion recognition systems, with potential applications in human-computer interaction, virtual assistants, and mental health monitoring. The study identifies and categorizes seven primary emotions within speech signals: Anger, Disgust, Neutral, Fear, Happy, Sad, and Surprise, providing a comprehensive framework for understanding and interpreting emotional cues in human speech.

articleTitle: Analytical Survey of Domain Effective Sentiment Lexicon for Aspect-Centric Opinion Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Aspect-level sentiment analysis is a modern technology that enables people to share their views or emotions with products, services, or topics based on their aspects. Aspect-level sentiment analysis focuses on aspect extraction, which considers aspects from user reviews. Various methods and approaches have been employed for aspect extraction. Although these methods show better performance and attempt to overcome various challenges, many unsolved problems still need to be solved, such as sentimental ambiguity, opinion misprediction, a weak sentiment lexicon, and implicit sentiment detection. Numerous sentiment lexicons have been employed for word polarity extraction. Dictionaries also play an important role in sentiment classification. There are various dictionaries, but it has been found that issues such as one dictionary might not work properly for all domains. This study analyzes various existing sentiment lexicons employed for domain-specific sentiment analysis. Various approaches have been employed to create a domain-dependent sentiment lexicon and its effect on aspect-level sentiment analyses.

articleTitle: JAR-Desktop Assistant
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In this paper, present JAR, a sophisticated desktop assistant meticulously crafted to redefine task execution by seamlessly blending voice and text inputs. JAR represents a paradigm shift in desktop interaction, empowering users with swift and intuitive control over their computing environment. By deftly managing application launches, file organization, and system adjustments based on user directives, JARVIS eliminates the drudgery of manual navigation, heralding a new era of productivity enhancement.Central to JAR’s prowess are its advanced processing algorithms, meticulously engineered to accurately interpret and execute user commands. This technological prowess enables JAR to engage in natural and intuitive interactions, effortlessly understanding and fulfilling user requests with precision. Moreover, JAR boasts a customizable interface and a suite of accessibility features, ensuring a tailored experience that caters to diverse user preferences and needs. At the heart of JAR lies its commitment to efficiency. Through efficient task management, JAR streamlines workflows, liberating users from mundane tasks and enabling them to focus on more meaningful endeavors. Whether it’s organizing files, scheduling tasks, or fine-tuning system settings, JARVIS excels in optimizing user productivity while conserving valuable time and energy.Through rigorous evaluation and user feedback, substantiate JAR’s effectiveness in enhancing desktop productivity and facilitating seamless computing experiences. By presenting JAR as a versatile and user-centric solution tailored to modern computing needs, our paper contributes to the advancement of desktop assistant technology, paving the way for a future where human-computer interaction is intuitive, efficient, and empowering.

articleTitle: Image and Video Captioning Using Deep Learning and Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Deep learning models have been a huge success in image recognition which hence can be used for the purpose of text generation. In the field of imaging science, captioning images and videos is regarded as an intellectually difficult job. Visual Geometry Group (VGG); is a standard deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture with multiple layers, specifically focusing on the integration of CNN for image feature extraction. Exploring this underlying method, the use of another model is essential for caption generation. Here the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) comes in use for caption generation from the extracted features. Models named Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) based on RNN and Bidirectional encoder representation transformer (BERT) based on Transformers have been prominent in ensuring accurate results. The Flicker8k dataset is used which provides a variety of information useful for model training. By testing validation data along with evaluation metrics, we analyze the effectiveness of different models to create consistent and descriptive headlines. Extending our inquiry to encompass title generation using transformer models, while also exploring learning techniques for real-time title generation and delivery using the Open-CV library available in Python to get the output from the camera and display it on screen. The result shows that the LSTM is the best model for captioning, with an accuracy of 65.07% at the epochs of 300 and the BERT model has an accuracy of 31% at the epochs of 2. The findings of this study not only contribute to advancing subtitle enhancement methodologies but also broaden the potential applications of deep learning techniques in this domain.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Bottle with Multiple Features Using Solar Module and USB Kit
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research paper explores the development and efficiency of a photovoltaic bottle equipped with transparent solar cells, a USB charging port, and a built-in filtration system designed to harness solar energy in a compact and sustainable manner. Through experimental analysis and performance evaluations, the research aims to contribute insights into the potential of this eco-friendly solution for powering small electronic devices or supporting low-energy applications. The paper discusses the design considerations, material selection, and the experimental methodology used to evaluate the device's energy harvesting performance and address water purification. The system not only extend to need of renewable energy usage but also provide us with portable technology and clean water access promoting a more sustainable future.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Approach to Graph Analysis and Equation Decoding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the realm of graph analysis, different methods are employed to derive curve equations, each showcasing distinctive traits. Manual graph plotting involves human intervention to meticulously plot data points and derive the curve equation, relying on mathematical techniques. In contrast, employing YOLO (You Only Look Once) algorithm for curve detection offers an automated, machine learning-based approach. YOLO, a computer vision model, autonomously identifies curves within graph images, bypassing human intervention. The manual method relies on subjective interpretation and mathematical rigor, whereas YOLO presents an automated, potentially more objective, and efficient means for curve detection through image analysis and machine learning algorithms, revolutionizing graph analysis paradigms.

articleTitle: Model Adaptation for Enhanced Liveness Face Detection: Experimental Findings on SiWMv2 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The field of liveness face detection, an essential component of security and biometrics, has seen notable advancements through developments in computer vision and deep learning. It’s crucial for accurately distinguishing between genuine and spoofed data samples. This study aims to elevate the performance of automated liveness face detection by focusing on model adaptation, utilizing the SiWMv2 dataset. This dataset is particularly valuable as it encompasses 14 kinds of spoofing attacks, that include print, replay attacks, obfuscation makeup, paper glasses, and various others, which significantly enhances the robustness of the detection systems against a wide array of spoofing techniques. By fine-tuning and adapting seven pre-trained architectures—VGG16, DenseNet201, InceptionV3, VGG19, ResNet50, MobileNetV2, and Xception—paper aims to push all boundaries of current automated liveness face detection capabilities. Through systematic experimentation and analysis, this study aims to contribute to the improvement and effectiveness of liveness face detection systems across various applications, ensuring they are more resilient and capable of handling diverse spoofing scenarios.

articleTitle: Unlocking Communication: YOLO Sign Language Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: One of the most important methods for helping deaf-mute persons communicate with is the detecting the hand gesture of deaf and mute community people. A sign language detection system tracks and recognizes the meaningful expressions of humans-made with their heads, arms, hands, fingers, etc. In this paper, we propose YOLO (You Only Look Once) based sign recognition method, focus on improving the traditional sign language recognition accuracy. The proposed system uses a camera to capture images of person hand gesture, then annotate the collected image with bounding boxes around the hand gesture and then processing of image frame is done by Roboflow [1] to detect and recognize the hand gestures. Hand gestures are then further classified and mapped to corresponding words and phrases in sign language using algorithms. Since there have been many existing sign language recognition systems which are designed using convolutional neural network, algorithms but they are not real-time detector. In this paper, we focused to create a real-time detection of hand gestures using a webcam. Even with a small dataset size, the system achieves a good degree of accuracy.

articleTitle: Bridging The Gap: ISL Fingerspelling to Text, Sentiment Analysis and Language Conversion
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Sign language plays a important role in facilitating communication for people with disabilities. However, even in modern times, there remains a noticeable gap in communication among people who are fluent in sign language and those who are not. Moreover, traditional day to day sign language systems more often rely solely on direct word recognition but this method falls short for when individuals seek to convey proper nouns, such as names. To solve this issue, this research introduces an innovative initiative for real-time Indian Sign Language (ISL) fingerspelling recognition to predict letters and combining them to form words, with a spacebar on a keyboard to indicate spaces, enabling the capture of complete sentences, Furthermore the system includes text translation and audio synthesis of the translated text in the language preferred by the user while supporting over 30+ languages, thereby addressing communication barriers for the deaf, blind, and non-sign language users. This paper presents a resnet50 model with accuracy of 99.06 and validation accuracy of 99.81 to recognize Indian sign language and a LSTM model for sentiment analysis with accuracy of 97.64% and test accuracy 97.81 %.

articleTitle: Streamlining Job Search and Detecting Fraudulent Job Listing
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In today’s job market to explore how various contextual factors influence the accuracy of automatically detecting online recruitment fraud, this study seeks to highlight the significance of tailoring such fraud detection methods to local contexts. To achieve these goals, the study initially creates a dataset using a local and semi-structured advertising platform. This dataset is then utilized to train a machine learning model, which considers a range of content-based and contextual features. The study’s findings indicate that the incorporation of contextual features enhances the performance of automated online recruitment fraud detection models. The practical implications of this research are twofold. First, the contextual feature generation engine can be applied to diverse data-sets with minimal localization efforts. Second, these machine learning models can be integrated into online job recruitment platforms to identify and prevent online recruitment fraud.

articleTitle: Trust-Based Routing Protocols for MANETs: Ensuring Security and Reliability
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: A wireless network of decentralized type as Mobile Ad hoc Network (MANET) is such a network which has been growing intensively now a day, which promise to become an ever-present technology. MANET is famous for its architecture that is characterized by their highly dynamic topology, mobility, broadcast nature of wireless communication. As it promises to give these much functionalities, it must be reliable enough to use it for long-lasting purpose. In MANET, path connecting between two nodes changes continuously as it is having dynamic nature, which can be result into uncertainty in the network performance. Also it consists with broadcast nature which can be further taken as a capability to increase the size of the network. Reliability is one of the important criteria in the network as we aware MANET is self-creating network and of short-duration (certain communication) as well is having unpredictability in environment. It is necessary that system or network should work effortlessly even when some issues have been occurred or some attack takes place. It should be reliable enough to retrieve from these circumstances successfully or up to the great extent. This states that network should be reliable enough to work with any constraints (Such as uncertainty) faithfully. Trust towards each node is key through which the MANET can improve the performance in every possible state. This research work focuses on the reliability of the network which is closely related with Trust as Belief. The work proposes Reliable AODV (RAODV) protocol which is extension of plain AODV MANET routing protocol. İn RAODV protocol trust is integrated with 3 variants: Direct Trust, Indirect Trust and Global Trust. Experimental analysis shows that RAODV improves the performance of MANET. The proposed method can effectively implement MANET reliability, as demonstrated by the simulation findings and related discussions.

articleTitle: Generative AI in Education: A Bibliometric and Thematic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research paper uses the bibliometric analysis technique to find out the current stage and future scope of research in the field of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the education sector. Generative AI which is demonstrated by popular platforms like ChatGPT, has emerged as a transformative force. It has offered a personalized learning environment, adaptive instruction, and opportunities for creative exploration for the students. The analysis done in this research paper is based on the data collected from the Scopus database. It shows the publication trends, geographical distribution, citation patterns, and thematic clusters of published research articles and conference papers in the recent past. The findings of this study reveal that the countries like United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia have significant research contributions with research themes spanning student-centred learning, medical and science education, and computing and information systems education. This research paper has identified the direction for future research which focuses on ethical considerations, teacher training, interdisciplinary collaboration, and inclusiveness. This research provides valuable insights into the growing field of Generative AI in education and guides future endeavours aiming at optimizing the educational outcome with responsible AI integration into the educational sector.

articleTitle: Retrieval Augmented Generation Approach for Multipdf Chatbot using LangChain
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper presents an AI-driven application designed to facilitate information retrieval and conversational interactions through uploaded PDF documents. In an era where a vast amount of information is contained within PDFs, it is essential to have efficient extraction and interaction mechanisms. The purpose of this paper is to bridge the gap between users and the wealth of knowledge contained in these documents. The research problem is addressed by utilizing advanced AI technologies to streamline document processing and enhance user engagement. The paper emphasizes the importance of efficient information retrieval and user-friendly interfaces in addressing existing challenges in accessing and discussing content within PDF documents. Methodologically, the paper integrates various technologies, including Google’s Generative AI and FAISS, to enable seamless document processing, text segmentation, and embedding generation. Key findings underscore the effectiveness of the implemented methodologies in facilitating interactive communication and extracting relevant information from PDFs. The paper’s conclusions highlight the it’s utility as a versatile tool for knowledge sharing and information retrieval. Limitations are acknowledged, emphasizing the need for ongoing research and improvement in addressing emerging challenges. Overall, this research contributes to advancing AI-driven applications for document processing and interactive communication, paving the way for enhanced knowledge accessibility and user engagement in diverse domains.

articleTitle: AyUR-bot: A Revolutionary Ayurvedic Chatbot Empowered by Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This study introduces AyUR-bot, a 24/7 Ayurvedic expert chatbot designed for prompt addressing of user queries on nutrition, remedies, and overall wellness. Project objectives include developing an Ayurvedic chatbot using NLP and deep learning, providing accurate responses, optimizing model efficiency, educating users about Ayurveda, and contributing to health and wellness through interactive conversations. The user-friendly chat interface allows effortless query submission. AyUR-bot leverages NLP tools, integrating the Llama 2 Large Language Model (LLM) and implementing Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) for question answering, optimizing Ayurvedic knowledge accessibility. The development process involves curating a specialized Ayurvedic document repository and utilizing the Llama 2 LLM model from Hugging Face. AyUR-bot ensures precise responses with unique stopping conditions. Components like the conversational retrieval chain, recursive character text splitter, and embeddings generator synergize for comprehensive responses. Evaluation with BERT Score validates AyUR-bot's effectiveness in delivering context-aware insights. The user-friendly interface enables interactive engagement, facilitating personalized Ayurvedic guidance. This research converges chatbot technology, NLP, and Ayurveda, aligned with project objectives, catering to the growing interest in traditional wellness, democratizing access to Ayurvedic wisdom. AyUR-bot results in a significant advancement in personalized Ayurvedic assistance.

articleTitle: Document Generation and Validation using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Counterfeit educational diplomas are a prevalent issue, stemming from the large number of graduates and a lack of efficient anti-forgery measures. Traditional document certification and verification processes are time-consuming. The proposed solution is a blockchain-based digital document system, which enhances security and transparency. This system converts paper documents into electronic files, calculates their hash values, and stores them in a blockchain, making forgery less likely. By identifying security themes and addressing gaps in the current blockchain verification, the system creates QR codes and inquiry codes for attaching to paper documents, enabling easy verification via mobile scanning or website inquiries. This addresses the pressing issue of counterfeit documents. This article describes a blockchain technology algorithm for validating digital certificates. As the number of university and higher education students and graduates continues to grow each year, there is a need to easily validate graduation certificates. In this paper, we intend two financial models in which the price of services is balanced between graduates and employers as the main actors of services. Students demand cheap and easily verifiable certificates, and employers demand fast and reliable proof of their degrees. The issue of fake credentials is a big one. Getting a fake education certificate in India is not that difficult. Companies that hire thousands of freshmen spend a lot of money verifying applicants’ educational credentials and qualifications.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Economic and Demographic Factors on Women’s FMCG Perspective and Behavior Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Leveraging Machine Learning (ML) techniques, the analytical study aims to unravel the underlying drivers influencing women’s perspectives & buying behavior. The ML investigation is to meticulously analyze the impact of economic & demographic variables on women’s buying behavior with FMCG products. A comprehensive primary survey dataset was collected. It was preprocessed before analysis to address any outliers or inconsistencies. Employed feature selection techniques such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Explained Variance and Cumulative Variance are used to identify the most relevant economic and demographic variables. ML algorithms such as regression analysis, decision tree, and clustering methods were employed for analysis of the dataset to uncover patterns, correlations and predictive insights. The performance of ML models was evaluated by using Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 score, Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) & confusion matrix. Through in-depth analysis & interpretation, we elucidate the key economic & demographic factors influencing Women’s behavior of FMCG products. The study reveals economic influences, like income level & spending habits; demographic dynamics, like education level, age, & lifestyle preferences; regional variances; & emerging trends, like product preferences, geographic location, and product access. This ML investigation helps shed light on complex dynamics shaping women’s perspectives & behaviors to empower stakeholders to make informed decisions that drive positive outcomes.

articleTitle: Integrated Vehicle Accidental Alert: IoT Based Intelligent System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In contemporary transportation systems, ensuring safety is of paramount significance, particularly in areas prone to hazards or requiring specific precautions, such as school zones and construction sites. This paper presents the design and implementation of an Integrated Vehicle Accidental Alert System leveraging the capabilities of the ESP32 microcontroller, Arduino Uno, and RF communication technology. The system is designed to monitor vehicle locations using a GPS module interfaced with the ESP32 microcontroller. Upon detecting the entry of a vehicle into a designated danger area, the Arduino Uno in the transmitter module, powered by a solar panel and battery setup, sends a signal via an RF transmitter. This signal is received by an RF receiver within the vehicle, which the Arduino Uno in the receiver module processes to trigger an audio playback and storage module that broadcasts pre-recorded safety messages tailored to specific hazard-prone areas. Concurrently, the ESP32 microcontroller uses its Wi-Fi capabilities to match live GPS coordinates and send notifications to a Blynk mobile application, providing real-time alerts to users regarding the vehicle's proximity to danger zones. This dual-notification system enhances safety measures by ensuring that both the driver and relevant stakeholders are promptly informed of potential risks. The system architecture employs a seamless integration of hardware components and software algorithms, facilitating efficient communication and response mechanisms. By leveraging emerging technologies and integrating them into a cohesive framework, this system contributes to the advancement of intelligent transportation systems aimed at mitigating accidents and promoting public safety. The solution is scalable and adaptable for diverse environments, including school zones, construction sites, and high-traffic areas.

articleTitle: Multiple Intelligence Evaluation Using Dermatoglyphics for Identifying Leardarad Types and Personality in Children
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Nowadays, people are more concerned about understanding their children's leardarad types and personality traits. Every individual has a unique personality and innate potential. It is very important to identify inborn talent which can further help to understand the course of interest at a young age. So that they can make the most of the available opportunities in life. Understanding someone's personality can help us to identify in which field they can perform well. The goal of this research paper is to automate the time-consuming manual work. Our research suggests a better way to identify leardarad type and personality based on the fingerprint. Certain elements of brain development and fingerprints are simultaneously produced during fetal development by the combination of hereditary and environmental variables.With the help of dermatoglyphics, we can recognize innate potentials, multiple intelligences, and personality traits from the fingerprints of the person. The suggested system takes scanned fingerprints as input. These scanned images undergo image processing. The images are converted into black and white format using grayscaling. These images are then filtered using a bilateral filter. Morphological operations are also performed on these images. The Gabor filtering technique is used for image enhancement. Features are extracted and dimensionality is reduced using Principle component analysis. A convolutional neural network is trained to accurately identify into seven categories. GradCam technique is used for model evaluation. Thus, we generate a report based on the identified finger type to recommend the leardarad type and personality trait.

articleTitle: IoT based Intelligent Parking System for Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the era of smart cities with Internet of Things every time there is a need of innovative and sustainable solutions for parking and smart cities management. The solutions which are developed are not sufficient enough to derive the best and sustainable outcomes. In densely populated areas in metro cities with high compactness, due to the insufficiency of parking space, many vehicles navigate searching for available parking spaces, requiring time to locate a suitable parking spot. The search for parking leads to various challenges like consumption of time, fuel consumption, traffic congestion, air pollution, and stress on drivers. The implementation of an intelligent parking system gives solutions to optimize the time, reduce fuel consumption and carbon emission and most importantly keep drivers free from stress.The main objective of this paper is to perform comprehensive study and present the analysis of Intelligent parking systems on the basis of networking technologies, various technical and computational approaches, user interfaces and services provided. This study will provide the clear idea of a design for sustainable intelligent parking system in various environments having its advantages, disadvantages, and research gap. Future scope of this work is to provide the opportunity to researchers, policy makers and other stakeholders to design and implement intelligent parking system in metro cities.

articleTitle: Anti-Counterfeit Product Identification System: A Paradigm Shift in Supply Chain Integrity
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Counterfeiting is a continuous and global issue that afflicts sectors, undermines consumer trust, and causes economic harm. To effectively fight this issue, the Anti-Counterfeit Product Identification System Using Blockchain has developed as a novel solution. This article provides an in-depth examination of this game-changing solution, which uses blockchain technology, QR codes, smart contracts, and the Ethereum network to provide a secure and transparent platform for certifying items across several industries. This study emphasizes the system's critical role in tackling complicated supply chain difficulties by providing a tamper-proof way for verifying product authenticity. The document describes the fundamental technologies used, significant features, and essential project setup steps. Finally, this approach has the potential to drastically reduce counterfeit goods while also creating transparency and confidence among supply chain players ranging from manufacturers to consumers, making it a critical tool in today's linked and fragile marketplaces.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Time Series Forecasting Models for Weather Prediction: ARIMA vs. STL
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research compares two well-known models for predicting weather: ARIMA (Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average) and STL (Seasonal-Trend Decomposition using Loess). Accurate weather forecasts are crucial for businesses and daily life, making strong forecasting methods necessary. ARIMA finds linear patterns and time dependencies in data, while STL splits time series into seasonal, trend, and random parts. Using real-world weather data, we train and test these models. We compare their performances using MSE (Mean Squared Error) and R2 (R-squared) metrics. The research demonstrates that the STL model performs better than the ARIMA model at accurately predicting weather patterns and fitting to the data. This superior performance makes the STL model a more dependable choice for weather forecasting. This study enhances techniques for weather prediction and offers valuable information to those making decisions in weather-sensitive businesses.

articleTitle: Backend Development for E-Commerce Application
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In an era of rapid digitalization, local communities face a growing challenge with access to essential services. Scattered information limited online presence, and inadequate infrastructure often leave residents struggling to find necessities like healthcare, education, transportation, and even daily groceries. This research proposes a novel solution for a hyper-local e-commerce platform specifically designed to cater to the needs of local communities. This website provides a one-stop online portal where residents can easily locate and access essential services within their immediate vicinity. Think hospitals, schools, colleges, grocery stores, and even local flight bookings – all neatly organized and readily available with just a few clicks. This platform, unlike traditional e-commerce giants, focuses on hyper-localization, catering to a specific geographical area and building strong connections with local businesses and service providers. This platform encourages participation in the community and economic empowerment. This gives the community vitality and diversity while also assisting small businesses in the area. This platform has the potential to significantly impact the creation of a more dynamic and sustainable future for everybody by empowering local communities and bridging the digital gap.

articleTitle: Fun Soundify: Music Generation powered by AI
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Fun Soundify embodies an exciting exploration at the intersection of artificial intelligence and artistic ingenuity, marking a bold step forward in the realm of music composition. Inspired by pioneering research in neural network-based music generation, our endeavor is to push the boundaries of creativity within the musical domain. Exploring advanced deep learning models, including Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Long Short-Term Memory networks (LSTMs), and attention mechanisms, our objective is to revolutionize music creation and appreciation. Drawing from insights gleaned from the original study, we have adapted and expanded upon these findings to construct an innovative AI-driven platform. Our mission is centered around unraveling the complexities of musical language and structure, with a particular emphasis on generating melodies infused with human-like creativity and emotion. Leveraging a diverse dataset and state-of-the-art machine learning techniques, our aspiration is to compose melodies that not only captivate but also inspire. Fun Soundify's AI-Powered Melodies Generation project serves as a testament to the limitless possibilities that machine learning offers in the realm of artistic innovation. Beyond merely crafting captivating melodies, our vision extends to fostering collaborative creation between humans and machines.

articleTitle: Cognitive Cardiovascular Disease Prediction Using ECG-Crown Auto Encoder Neural Network for ECG Time Series Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Cognitive computing research in cardiovascular disease prediction is needed in the post-COVID-19 era. Recently, post-vaccination anomalies have been declared at certain levels throughout the world, and in rare cases, the vaccine causes Thrombosis Thrombocytopenia Syndrome, which causes blood clot formation. The core threat is that if such clots travel to heart arteries, there is a possibility of sudden cardiac arrest, cardiac arrhythmia diseases, and other heart diseases. The heart’s function can identify such threats, and the primary tool for cardiac function tests is an electrocardiogram (ECG). So, analyzing the heart rate and heartbeat status more accurately is necessary. The manual analysis for cardiac arrhythmia using ECG requires manual QRS-complex identification, which may mislead the precise disease prediction. Hence, the proposed research focuses on fast decision by enhancing the cognitive computing accuracy of ECG signals through the proposed ECG-Crown autoencoder with an LSTM sequential model. The ECG-Crown auto-encoder neural network gives fast classification results as the downsampling is executed concurrently, making the arrhythmia prediction possible even for a single heartbeat by ECG waveform R-R peak analysis. Hence, the proposed model performance is very impressive compared to existing techniques. The proposed system is tested with ECG time series signal data, and the results are very promising, with 99.7% accuracy. The model loss recorded minimum, which lowers the classification error and subsequently helps to predict a cardiovascular disease very accurately.

articleTitle: Headgear Compliance in Development Sectors Through Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The paper introduces a comprehensive approach to enhance safety practices in high-risk professions, specifically focusing on headgear compliance in the transportation and construction sectors. Leveraging the advancements of the You Only Look Once (YOLO) algorithm, particularly the YOLOv8-L model, the study presents a novel helmet and vest detection system for real-time monitoring of personal protective equipment (PPE). The YOLOv8-L model, with its compact size of 21 MB and rapid single epoch run-time of 11 seconds, achieved an impressive mean average precision (mAP) accuracy rate of 96.8%. The system, trained on a meticulously curated dataset encompassing various lighting conditions, camera angles, and helmet types, highlights robust performance, attaining a recall of 0.99 and an average precision of 0.99. The implementation of this deep learning algorithm not only ensures efficient and reliable detection of safety helmets but also significantly contributes to improving safety measures in hazardous work environments, thereby promoting headgear compliance, and reducing accidents in the transportation and construction sectors.

articleTitle: Emergency Department Asthma Management: Harnessing Clustering Algorithms for Enhanced Precision Medicine
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Precision medicine is essentially a modern approach to understanding health. Treatment decision support systems, or TDSSs, are a crucial part of modern health care methods. They are designed to close the knowledge gap between patients' initial knowledge and the comprehensive information required to make well-informed treatment decisions. Asthma remains a significant public health concern, particularly in the Emergency Department (ED) setting, where swift and accurate management is paramount. In our research we used clustering algorithms to scrutinize clustering accuracy, clinical significance, computational efficiency, and pinpointed the optimal approach with 88.43% of K-means Algorithm and 88.28% of Density-based Algorithm of correctly categorized instances. Based on accuracy and a balanced cluster distribution, Simple K-means and Density-based algorithms achieve more effective examples for individualized decision-making that produce informative outcomes. Through the application of advanced data analytics tools and precision medicine concepts, our research aims to optimize asthma management in the emergency department to streamline healthcare delivery and reduce costs. We seek to improve outcomes and reduce healthcare utilization by personalizing therapy recommendations for asthma patients by integrating clustering algorithms into treatment decision support systems (TDSS).

articleTitle: A Research Review on Challenges of Federated Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) offers a decentralized approach to model training, preserving data privacy, scalability, and diversity compared to centralized methods. By distributing computational tasks across devices and facilitating localized training, FL minimizes communication burdens and ensures secure handling of sensitive data. This innovative technique enables organizations to train AI models collaboratively on distributed data without central storage or sharing, thereby preserving privacy and advancing machine learning capabilities. Preserving privacy in federated learning (FL) presents multi-faceted challenges, including diverse data distributions, communication security risks, and potential privacy leaks during aggregation. Maintaining model efficacy while implementing effective privacy-preserving techniques is crucial, necessitating a careful balance between privacy and performance. Additionally, ad- dressing vulnerabilities to model inversion attacks and ensuring participant compliance with privacy protocols adds complexity to FL systems. To overcome these challenges, innovative solutions and robust security measures are imperative to safeguard user privacy and uphold FL model efficacy while prioritizing fairness and privacy preservation.

articleTitle: A Review on Darknet and Cyber Threat to Society, Counter Measures and Challenges and Trends in Cyber Security and Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Smart technologies with the help of internet add an essence of ubiquity to things as well make the world smaller than ever. Cyber technologies have made the data transfer, exchange and access easier even though being anywhere in the world. With the comfort and ease to the lives in society, advanced and cyber technologies have opened new approaches for the criminals to threaten the society. Darknet among the all other web is non-indexed and encrypted by non-standard protocols that makes it anonymous. An anonymity of darknet has attracted the cyber criminals and has given a swiftness to the cybercrime. To cope up with the raise in the cybercrime, advancement in the cyber security has become a necessity. It is crucial to detect the malicious traffic to avoid cyber traps. This paper gives the review of darknet crime and activities ongoing on darknet and cybercrime activities. A review of cyber security measures and techniques against cyber-crime has been provided in this article. The challenges and trends in the cyber security and intrusion detection have been discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Sign Language Translation System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Sign language is an essential form of communication for the deaf and hard-of-hearing community. The creation of Bidirectional Sign Language Translation Systems (BSLTS) has drawn a lot of attention as technology has advanced. The first section of the article gives a general review of the difficulties in translating and recognising sign language, highlighting the urgent need for precise and timely solutions. After that, it explores the fundamental ideas of CNN and Sign language, emphasising their advantages. The survey discusses different architectures and techniques used for feature extraction and classification, and it thoroughly evaluates the body of research on CNN's use in sign language recognition. Additionally, the study investigates how the cutting-edge object detection technology YOLO3 improves the spatial comprehension of sign language gestures. This investigation investigates how real-time object identification capabilities of YOLO3 can enhance the accuracy and efficiency of BSLTS, enabling smooth communication between sign language users and non-signers. Sign language is a communication method used by people with speech and hearing impairments to interact with others who are not handicapped. Normal people don't use sign language very often, and it takes a lot of time and effort to understand signs. People with hearing impairments are cut off from the outside world and seldom engage in social interactions due to this communication gap. A system for converting text to sign and sign to text is required to tackle this issue and facilitate communication. For system training, a variety of methods have been employed, including Sign language and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN).

articleTitle: Generative AI Powered Forensic Device
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Crime is a dominant concern in contemporary society. It is crucial to prevent it and deliver justice promptly. Forensic science is critical for criminal investigations and maintaining law and order. The traditional tactics utilized in this field are frequently based on manual procedures, which are both time-consuming and prone to error, rendering them ineffectual in providing prompt and dependable justice. Utilizing automation and advanced technologies for forensic science and crime scene investigation is now essential. This paper suggests a portable gadget that utilizes Internet of Things (IOT), Machine Learning and Deep Learning to predict, gain understanding, and possibly recognize offenders. This gadget is designed to reconstruct fingerprints, detect weapons and recognize suspicious activities. It utilizes algorithms and technologies like autoencoders, GANs, SSD and YOLOv8. We talk about the benefits of merging these technologies into one easy-to-use device, which will offer data integration, instant data processing, and improved forensic analysis. The article offers information about automating important areas to improve investigative processes and enhance the criminal justice system's efficiency and effectiveness in the future.

articleTitle: Mosquito Optimizer: A Nature-inspired Meta-heuristic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Mosquitoes employ a sophisticated combination of sensory cues to locate and feed on hosts. This paper elucidates the sequential steps involved in mosquito hunting behavior, encompassing host cue detection, attraction to hosts, utilization of visual cues, landing and feeding mechanisms, and sensing of danger. The hunting behavior may vary among species and is influenced by environmental factors. To optimize this behavioral model, a Mosquito Optimizer Algorithm (MOA) is proposed. The algorithm entails the representation of candidate solutions akin to mosquito sensory cues, initialization of solution populations, exploration of the search space through fitness evaluation, exploitation of promising solutions, and adaptation to threats. Termination criteria are defined to conclude the optimization process. Mathematically, the optimization process involves defining an objective function to be optimized, initializing solution populations, evaluating fitness, updating the global best position, adjusting direction towards attractive targets, updating velocities, and iteratively updating positions based on velocities until termination criteria are met. The proposed algorithm demonstrates efficacy in solving optimization problems, drawing inspiration from mosquito hunting behavior and offering potential applications across various domains. The source code is available at: https://github.com/Alqushaibi/MOA.

articleTitle: Meta-Heuristic-enabled Adaptive Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Heart disease has posed a severe threat to the well-being of individuals in recent years due to its widespread incidence and elevated mortality rate. As a result, early detection of heart disease using basic physical signs derived from routine physical examinations has grown into an important topic. Yet, the vast volume of information makes evaluation and forecasting process more difficult. Thus, an automated heart disease prediction framework is presented in this paper with the help of meta-heuristic-enabled deep learning. Firstly, the requisite data are collected from the available resources and the attained data are processed into the feature extraction phase. The t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE) method is employed for extracting the features from the obtained data and this model supports to reduce the dimensionality of the data. Subsequently, the resultant features are forwarded to the heart disease prediction phase, where the 1-Dimensional Adaptive Convolutional Neural Network (1D-ACNN) is introduced. Moreover, the parameters are optimized in this network by the Improved Dung Beetle Optimizer Algorithm (IDBO). Thus, the heart disease-predicted data are obtained in the end with the support of the 1D-ACNN network, and the implemented model is contrasted with existing algorithms and prediction techniques to ensure the system efficacy.

articleTitle: Synergizing Environmental Computing, Agricultural Engineering, and AI for Sustainable ICT Applications in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This conference paper delves into the transformative synergy of Environmental Computing, Agricultural Engineering, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to forge sustainable ICT applications in agriculture. By amalgamating these domains, the paper unravels how AI-driven insights are harnessed to optimize resource allocation, mitigate environmental impact, and empower precision farming practices. This fusion not only enhances agricultural productivity and efficiency but also lays the foundation for ecologically mindful agricultural activities. The integration of AI further enriches Agricultural Engineering’s potential by enabling data-driven decision-making through sensor data analysis, satellite imagery, and climate models, thus fostering resilience and productivity across the agricultural value chain. In sum, this exploration underscores the pivotal role of AI in shaping a sustainable future for ICT applications in agriculture through the harmonious interplay of Environmental Computing and Agricultural Engineering.

articleTitle: Exploring Advanced Approaches in Wind Speed Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research looks at the use of machine learning models for wind speed forecasting, addressing the challenges caused by wind speed’s tremendous variability and unpredictability. The paper examines numerous models, such as the Weibull distribution, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), Support Vector Machines (SVMs), Linear Regression, and Decision Trees to show the advantages of machine learning models over traditional statistical approaches. Because wind patterns are irregular and frequently changing, complicated forecasting techniques are required. This study suggests that machine learning models be used to address this complexity successfully. By looking into historical wind speed data and considering a myriad of influencing factors, these models display outstanding abilities in capturing the complexities of wind behavior. Temperature, humidity, pressure, and wind direction all interact complexly, underlining their combined effect on wind velocity. The ability to grasp these multi-dimensional linkages through machine learning paves the way for more precise projections. These findings are consistent with the objective of the renewable energy sector, which is to improve wind turbine performance. By allowing operators to proactively alter turbine settings depending on projected wind speeds, these models contribute to enhanced energy generation efficiency and lower operating costs, reinforcing the case for their inclusion in the renewable energy environment.

articleTitle: Liver Cirrhosis Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Cirrhosis is a serious disease characterized by progressive scarring of the liver, leading to liver failure and potentially life-threatening complications. Early detection and prognosis of liver cirrhosis are crucial for timely treatment and patient recovery. In this project, we developed a cirrhosis prediction system that uses machine learning algorithms to help healthcare professionals identify individuals at risk of developing cirrhosis. Using datasets rich in clinical and demographic information, our system uses a variety of machine learning techniques, such as decision trees, logistic regression, and random forests, to predict the probability of developing cirrhosis. Through careful evaluation and comparison of these algorithms, we evaluate their performance in terms of accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and area under the curve (AUC). Results demonstrate the effectiveness of our predictive system to accurately identify individuals at risk of cirrhosis, facilitating early intervention and personalized medical care. This project advances the development of predictive health analytics and highlights the potential of machine learning to improve patient outcomes in cirrhosis care. Future research directions include refinement of predictive models, integration of additional data sources, and validation through future clinical trials. Overall, our cirrhosis prediction system promises to be a valuable tool for healthcare providers in the proactive management of this debilitating condition.

articleTitle: Patient Privacy and Data Security in the Era of AI-Driven Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly integrated into healthcare systems, concerns about patient privacy and data security have become paramount. This paper examines the implications of AI-driven technologies on patient privacy and data security, focusing on theoretical frameworks and practical approaches to mitigate risks and enhance protections. Through a comprehensive literature review, theoretical models, and ethical analyses, this study suggests ‘Integrated Security and Ethics Model.’ This framework addresses the dynamic nature of AI, the integration of ethical considerations into security practices, and the need for comprehensive governance and risk management strategies. The findings highlight the importance of balancing the benefits of AI in healthcare with the protection of patient privacy and data security. The proposed framework offers actionable guidance for policymakers, healthcare providers, and AI developers to ensure that AI technologies are implemented responsibly and ethically. Future research directions, policy implications, and practical recommendations are also discussed. This study contributes to advancing the understanding of patient privacy and data security in the context of AI-driven healthcare, aiming to foster a safer and more ethical AI ecosystem in healthcare settings.

articleTitle: Novel Multi-Stage Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework for the Cybersecurity of In-Vehicle Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Objective - To develop a deep learning-based robust threat detection system for in-vehicle networks of autonomous vehicles to differentiate normal vehicle operation from potential cyber-attacks.Method - The Controller Area Network (CAN) network traffic dataset, including both attack and normal messages, was used for the study. Several features were present in this dataset, including class and subclass designations that help to differentiate between legitimate operational signals and possible attack messages. Feature engineering techniques were applied to the dataset. Data preparation was done after feature engineering, with the main goal being to make it ready to train the model.After pre-processing the data, three distinct neural network architectures were applied utilizing a multi-task and multi-stage approach: convolutional neural network, long short-term memory, and artificial neural network. The most appropriate and useful model for the specific context was then identified by comparing the accuracies of different models.Result - With a multistage approach, the convolutional neural network model demonstrated remarkable training accuracies of 98.10% for Stage I (classifying attack or normal condition) and 99.08% for Stage II (classifying type of attack). Also, the Stage I and Stage II testing accuracies were 98.08% and 99.09%

articleTitle: Navigating the Intersections of Quantum Computing, DNA-Based Data Storage, and Geospatial Data Security: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In recent years, the intersection of quantum computing and bioinformatics has emerged as a captivating frontier, promising to reshape the landscape of biological sequence analysis. DNA's ability to store vast information and its stability make it a candidate for secure geospatial data storage. Quantum computing, exemplified by QKD, transforms encryption, enhancing security. Bio-inspired algorithms, emulating DNA sequences, optimise problem-solving. Combining these with quantum computing improves geospatial data security through protocol enhancements. Quantum bioinformatics explores quantum computing's potential in genetics and medicine, indirectly reinforcing data security. Integration of DNA-based storage with quantum encryption ensures highly secure data transmission. Geospatial data can be encoded in DNA sequences and encrypted for network transmission. This convergence promises enhanced data security, though implementation needs further research. Overall, these innovations hold potential for advancing geospatial data security.

articleTitle: Analyzing the efficacy of Deep Learning and Transformer models in classifying Human and LLM-Generated Text
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Large Language Models (LLM) are widely accepted by the humans for their powerful ability to understand, follow and create human-like text. The text generation capabilities of LLMs have reached such a height that it is now comparable to text generated by human.LLMs are a powerful subset of Artificial Intelligence (AI)models, trained on huge amount of human-written text to create indistinguishable content. AI models have taken an important step ahead in constructing hyper-realistic content which can be in any modality such as text, image, and video. The output content generated by these models can be hard to distinguish from human-written content as these models are iteratively trained on texts written by human. Further this has got serious implications across various domains, including news reporting, information fraud, academic plagiarism, data manipulation, financial fraud, theft and deep fakes. The abilities of AI-generated text pose a significant challenge, blurring the lines of differentiation between human and machine-created content. Therefore, to effectively navigate the evolving landscape of AI-generated text, we need a robust and reliable AI text detection model. This study leverages a substantial dataset of 100,000 entries. empowering our model with adaptability across various domains. By employing diverse word embedding techniques along with machine and deep learning models, we explore optimal configurations for exceptional performance. Notably, we implement pre-trained models like BERT and DeBERTa on this extensive corpus, potentially representing the first such application. The resulting models demonstrate remarkable accuracy exceeding 95% across all configurations, signifying a robust advancement in differentiating AI generated text from human written one.

articleTitle: Deepfake Detection System using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Deepfake technology has emerged as a significant concern due to its potential to generate highly realistic fake content, including videos, audio recordings, and images. As the sophistication of deepfake algorithms continues to advance, there is an urgent need for effective detection methods to combat their misuse. In response to this challenge, we propose a Deepfake Detection System (DFDS) utilizing deep learning techniques. The DFDS is built upon state-of-the-art deep neural networks, leveraging convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to analyze various modalities of data, such as video frames and audio spectrograms, but in this we dedicated to video to detect inconsistencies and anomalies indicative of deepfake manipulation. The system is trained on a large-scale dataset comprising authentic and synthetic media samples, enabling it to learn complex patterns and features characteristic of deepfake content. Key components of the DFDS include feature extraction modules, fusion layers for integrating multimodal information, and decision-making mechanisms for classification. By exploiting the temporal and spatial dependencies inherent in multimedia data, our system achieves robust performance in identifying deepfake content across different scenarios and manipulation techniques. In conclusion, the Deepfake Detection System presented in this study offers a promising solution for combating the spread of malicious deepfake content. By harnessing the power of deep learning, our system provides a robust defense mechanism to safeguard against the harmful consequences of deepfake technology, thereby preserving the integrity and trustworthiness of digital media in the modern age.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey and Evaluation of MediaPipe Face Mesh for Human Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Human Emotion Recognition (HER) has become a crucial application within computer vision and artificial intelligence, facilitating advancements in human-computer interaction, robotics, and other domains. Among the myriad approaches, Facial Expression Recognition (FER) systems stand out as a prominent method for automated emotion detection. In this paper, we conduct an extensive survey of the diverse techniques, modalities, and datasets employed for emotion recognition, with primary emphasis on non-verbal cues, and facial expressions. We delve into the significance of facial landmark detection, a critical task in numerous applications such as face recognition and emotion detection. Using real-time data frames, we focus on leveraging the capabilities of the open-source MediaPipe Face Mesh, a real-time face geometry framework capable of estimating 468 3D face landmarks, to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of landmark detection. We evaluate its performance with two other open-source models namely DLIB and OpenPose and check their efficacy. From the results, it is observed that MediaPipe Face Mesh offers real-time performance and high accuracy, making it suitable for real-world applications with stringent latency requirements.

articleTitle: Automated Internship Report Duty System Using Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)

authors.preferredName: M Bahrul Ilmi B Mustapa Kamal

abstract: This project proposes an Automated Internship Report Duty System powered by Robotic Process Automation (RPA) to address the inefficiencies and errors associated with the current manual internship report process at Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS (UTP). The system integrates with Microsoft Power Platform and Office 365 to streamline processes, improve data accuracy, and enhance user experience for both students and administrators. Key functionalities include real-time filtering and suggestion for students during report form creation, automated data processing and document generation, and a robust emailing system for efficient communication. The system is designed to promote sustainability by reducing paper usage and energy consumption, while also fostering social sustainability by improving work-life balance for administrators and students. Furthermore, the system offers economic benefits by reducing administrative overhead costs. Overall, this RPA-powered system presents a comprehensive solution to enhance the internship experience, streamline processes, and promote sustainability for UTP's internship program.

articleTitle: Spam SMS Detection Using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: A spam SMS is an unsolicited text message dispatched to a large population, illegitimately, without the authorization of the recipients. Reports suggest that the number of Spam SMS received by citizens of any country is approximately 400 million, and this number is increasing day by day. These SMS messages may contain malicious links, causing security threats including phishing attacks and malware infections. Some spam SMS messages can involve fraudulent schemes, leading to financial losses for the receiver and can also cause privacy threats. Hence, there is an urge to detect these spam SMSs correctly and avoid the severe consequences for the recipients. The proposed study emphasizes the development of Natural Language Processing based Machine Learning models to identify spam SMS texts. The process involves tokenization of the SMS texts, stemming of the words, and many more abstractions of the keywords for easier classification. Firstly, the text messages are processed using NLP and then the processed data is trained on different ML algorithms. Multiple ML models are created and tested on various kinds of SMS messages for the detection of spam messages. This expert system ensures accurate and precise detection of received messages. This expert system intends to reduce the threats and safeguard the security and privacy of the consumers, by essentially recognizing and steering clear of spam SMS messages. This system aims to empower users with the tools and knowledge needed to navigate the digital landscape safely and securely.

articleTitle: Implementation of Diamond Security System Using Machine Learning and Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The pervasive challenges of counterfeit in the diamond industry, cybersecurity vulnerabilities and the looming threat of large-scale heists, akin to the infamous Antwerp money heist of 2003, underscore the critical need for innovative security solutions. The initiative addresses these pressing concerns through the fusion of machine learning algorithm and blockchain technology. The methodology entails a comprehensive dataset comprising thirty-two parameters for advanced detection and five dominant parameters for basic detection, catering to the both expert and novice users. Leveraging machine learning approaches which includes decision trees and ensemble learning, the system meticulously analyses these parameters to discern between natural and artificial diamonds with heightened accuracy. The accuracy of the models varies, with the highest achieving an impressive 98%, ensuring robust authentication and fraud prevention mechanisms. Furthermore, the verified data of natural diamonds is securely stored on a blockchain ledger, fortifying ownership records against tampering and ensuring transparency. This integrated approach not only safeguards the integrity of the diamond industry but also fosters trust and transparency among stakeholders. By providing a paradigm shift in security solutions, the system sets a new standard for authentication and fraud prevention in the diamond market, mitigating risks and empowering stakeholders with reliable, data-driven tools for decision-making.

articleTitle: Network Forensics using Deep Q-Networks and Explainable Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The increasing complexity and frequency of Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks demand sophisticated and effective network forensics methodologies. Utilizing Deep Q Networks (DQN) and Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques such as Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations (LIME) and DeepSHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations), our approach initiates with the collection of extensive data from various network endpoints. Employing k-Means Clustering for data preprocessing enhances dataset quality, a critical factor for accurate pattern detection and reducing redundancy. Transforming data into multiple representations extracts essential features, exposing hidden events that signal DDoS attacks. Our core approach involves network forensics analysis using a sophisticated DQN Classifier capable of identifying and analyzing intricate DDoS attack patterns, significantly reducing false positives and adapting to new attack vectors. Integration of LIME and DeepSHAP for XAI enhances interpretability, facilitating comprehension of the model’s decisions and fostering trust. By employing this methodology, organizations can substantially improve the accuracy and effectiveness of their network forensics efforts, maintain compliance with relevant regulations, and adapt to the ever-changing DDoS attack patterns that characterize the dynamic cybersecurity landscape.

articleTitle: DeepFish: A Comprehensive Exploration of Deep Learning Methods for Accurate Fish Species
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The DeepFish exploration aims to develop a web-based application that leverages deep learning algorithms to accurately identify and provide detailed information about various fish species based on user-uploaded images, specifically for the unique fish species in Maharashtra. The system utilizes state-of-the-art computer vision techniques to process the uploaded fish images and employs a trained model to predict the fish species. The paper presents a rigorous comparative analysis of deep learning algorithms, to accurately identify the most efficient model for our application with minimum response time and maximum accuracy for identification. The Fish Prediction website provides users with a brief description and relevant information about the predicted fish species including common habitat, diet, physical characteristics, and consumption status, enhancing their knowledge and understanding of the diverse aquatic life. Overall, it provides an accessible and user-friendly platform for fish identification and information retrieval, benefiting researchers, fishing enthusiasts, and conservationists

articleTitle: Utilizing Diverse Machine Learning Models for Liver Disease Patient Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The liver-damaging virus known as hepatitis C is still a major global health concern. The need for better early detection strategies is highlighted by the serious consequences that can arise from delayed diagnosis and treatment. This study investigates the possibility of using real-time data analysis and machine learning (ML) models to forecast cases of hepatitis C. The recommended method makes use of a number of data preprocessing strategies, such as resolving data imbalance, scaling features, and picking pertinent features to improve accuracy via appropriate imputations. Multivariate imputation fills in the missing values. Skewed columns are subjected to standardisation, min-max scaling, maximum absolute scaling, and robust scaling techniques in addition to the log1p transformation. The model’s output was compared both internally and to other models that had been employed in earlier studies. The suggested model outperformed alternative techniques with the highest testing accuracies of 91.82% and 86.06%, respectively, using extra tree classifier and random forest, indicating its potential as a practical solution for liver disease detection.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Deep Neural Language Models for Text Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Natural Language Generation (NLG) has emerged as a leading artificial intelligence tool, particularly for text generation. This work examines deep neural language models, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), and Gated Recurrent Units (GRU), from the standpoint of text synthesis. The study offers a comprehensive comparison of the effectiveness of each model, including their design, methods of training, and general performance in various text creation scenarios. Issues including vanishing gradients, comprehending the trade-offs between model complexity and performance, and determining the model's adaptation to other domains are all addressed throughout the examination. We investigate how well these models capture contextual subtleties and produce coherent, contextually relevant text across a wide range of applications, including chatbots, content generation, and summarization. We delve into the impact of model size, training data, and architectural nuances on the quality and efficiency of text generation. The results show that in terms of weighted average, accuracy, loss, and perplexity, GRU performs better than CNN, RNN, and LSTM.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of CNN Architectures for Enhancing Oral Cancer Detection Using Advanced Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: To effectively diagnose oral cancer, sophisticated technologies like deep learning must be investigated. This is still a significant difficulty in medical diagnostics. To assess Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures' efficacy in oral cancer detection, we compare and contrast them in this research. Specifically, we compare the performance of VGG19, ResNet50, ResNet101, and a standard CNN model using a dataset of Oral Cancer (Lips and Tongue) images (OCI). We use sophisticated image processing methods including data augmentation, contrast improvement, and noise reduction to improve the quality of the supplied data. We use accuracy, precision rate, recall rate, and F1-score as our assessment measures. Our findings show that the suggested CNN design outperforms VGG19 (72.97%), ResNet50 (79.73%), and ResNet101 (71.62%) in terms of accuracy, with a maximum of 87.10%. Moreover, our approach shows excellent recall, F1score, and accuracy, highlighting its efficacy in correctly detecting malignant areas in oral pictures. Through this comparative analysis, we provide valuable insights into the suitability of different CNN architectures for oral cancer detection, without the integration of specific optimization algorithms. Our findings highlight the potential of deep learning techniques to improve treatment outcomes and early diagnosis for patients with oral cancer, ultimately leading to the advancement of computer-aided cancer detection (CAD) systems.

articleTitle: Exploring the Potential of Prompt Engineering: A Comprehensive Analysis of Interacting with Large Language Models
