publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This article focused on exploring the core principles of prompt engineering, aiming to provide a comprehensive understanding of how to effectively interact with and instruct large language models (LLMs) using prompts. The article extensively covered various aspects of prompt engineering, including an analysis of its fundamental components, different types of prompts, ethical considerations in the prompting process, and the wide-ranging applications of prompt engineering. Additionally, the study conducted a comparative analysis between two conversational AI bots, ChatGPT 3.5 and BardAI, by subjecting them to similar prompts. The results of this comparison indicated a high level of similarity in their performances, suggesting that both bots are comparable in their capabilities. The study also highlighted the immense potential for further advancements in the field of prompt engineering. By investigating the intricacies of prompt design, ethical implications, and showcasing the promising applications, this article contributes significantly to the knowledge base surrounding prompt engineering. The findings not only shed light on the current state of the technology but also point towards numerous opportunities for future articles and development in this domain.

articleTitle: Prompt-based Generation of 3D Textured Human with Motion Rigging
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Recent advances in domains such as High Performance Computing (HPC) and proliferation of Machine Learning have led to great strides in the domain of 3D model generation. Several technologies, such as the Metaverse, AR/VR applications and game development have benefited tremendously from this phenomenon as it makes the tedious and time-consuming process of 3D modeling convenient. In real-world applications such as gaming, virtual reality, and augmented reality, 3D models with predefined articulated structures are essential for immersive experiences and lifelike animations. The solution proposed in this paper aims to expedite the arduous process of manually annotating articulation points within 3D models, a prevalent necessity with current models. By integrating an automated articulation definition mechanism into our model, we streamline the animation workflow and enhance user efficiency. With a CLIP Score of 0.548, the 3D model itself is sufficiently high quality enough to serve this purpose. This functionality enables expedited animation creation and fosters smoother workflow by providing predefined articulation points within the 3D models.

articleTitle: Gender and Age Detection Using Multimodal Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research article introduces an innovative method for identifying gender and age leveraging the capabilities of multimodal deep neural networks (DNN) integrated with OpenCV and Scikit-learn frameworks. The ability to accurately infer gender and age from facial images is crucial for various applications ranging from marketing analytics to security surveillance. However, achieving robust performance in real-world scenarios remains challenging due to variations in facial expressions, lighting conditions, and occlusions. To address these challenges, we propose a multimodal DNN architecture that fuses information from both facial images and accompanying metadata. Our model consists of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for image feature extraction and recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for processing sequential metadata. By integrating OpenCV, we preprocess the images to enhance their quality and extract facial features efficiently. Additionally, Scikit-learn is employed for metadata preprocessing and model evaluation. We conduct extensive experiments on benchmark datasets to evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed approach. The results demonstrate superior performance in gender and age classification compared to existing methods. This research contributes to the advancement of multimodal deep learning techniques for gender and age detection tasks. The integration of OpenCV and Scikit-learn facilitates seamless preprocessing, feature extraction, and evaluation, thereby enhancing the practical applicability of our approach.

articleTitle: Internet of Things (IoT): Trends, Challenges, Simulators, Emulators and Test-beds
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: During the past few years, the deployment and adoption of IoT in the world have increased significantly. The growth rate of IoT increases annually. Researchers today rate the security of IoT to determine its acceptance trend by the public. This paper answers five research questions that show the theme trends for the IoT development, the main challenges of IoT security, and the choice of simulators, emulators, and test-beds used to implement IoT scenarios. A comparison of the available tools/software/simulators that could run the IoT model is presented to give users insight to visualize the working concept of the IoT.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Energy Management System for Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The industrial sector, serving as a linchpin of global economic growth, continually shapes innovation, job creation, and wealth accumulation. However, its indispensable role is juxtaposed with substantial energy consumption, contributing significantly to the world’s energy usage and environmental footprint. In their pursuit of heightened competitiveness and profitability, industries confront a pressing challenge: the judicious management of energy resources. Striking a harmonious equilibrium between cost-efficiency, operational excellence, and environmental sustainability presents a formidable complexity. Compounding this complexity is the reluctance of traditional energy management methodologies to adapt to the dynamic and data-rich landscapes characterizing modern industrial domains. This research paper ventures into the heart of these challenges, exploring the convergence of the industrial sector, energy management, and technological advancements. Within this multifaceted landscape, it scrutinizes the intricacies of contemporary industrial environments, exposing the inherent complexities of responsible energy management. With data-driven technologies and advanced analytics as guiding lights, this study illuminates a transformative path forward—transcending conventional paradigms to forge a new era of efficiency, sustainability, and profitability.

articleTitle: Analysis of Conventional Techniques on Detecting DDoS Attack in Wireless Sensor Network with Varied Feature Combination
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Numerous security threats, such as sinkhole attacks, tampering attacks, and denial-of-service (DoS) assaults, are present in wireless sensor networks (WSNs). Thus, it is essential to design an effective system in order to identify and detect these assaults in WSNs in a timely manner. This article performs a thorough examination of several standard models used to identify intrusions in network environments. Features like statistical, higher order statistical features and technical indicators are considered in this analysis for the effective extraction of relevant features. Then, the conventional classifiers like Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Neural Network (NN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), and Deep Belief Network (DBN) is deployed and analysed with respect to the extracted features. At last, the conventional techniques are analyzed with varied feature combinations. By investigating these models, we hope to gain a better grasp of their strengths and limitations, opening the door for the creation of WSN intrusion detection systems (IDS’s) that are more successful. This research also adds significant insights to the continuing efforts intended at guaranteeing the security and dependability of WSNs across diverse applications and domains by illuminating the subtleties of intrusion detection models.

articleTitle: Enhancing Forest Safety: Sensor-Assisted Detection and Prevention of Wildfires
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper presents integrated forest fire detection and prevention system leveraging advanced sensor technologies, satellite monitoring, and UAVs. Data analytics and machine learning enhance accuracy, minimizing false alarms. Efficient communication with emergency services, public awareness campaigns, and community involvement are integral. The system aims to provide early detection, rapid response, and effective mitigation of wildfires, ensuring the safety of ecosystems and human communities. They cost more in India. In this paper we have discussed the effects of forest fires on India’s biodiversity, forest species, climate changes and soil properties along with the different approaches the Indian government has taken to prevent and control forest fires. The forest fires economic impact is estimated to be over INR 1101 crore/year. By observing this we try to put light on this topic.

articleTitle: FSCM Quality Control using Blockchain & IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Globally, the issue of food safety is getting increasingly critical and alarming. In order to tackle this straining situation, people would require a reliable food traceability system that is capable of monitoring and supervising every stage of the food generation process, right from the planting and harvesting of raw food materials to the manufacturing, processing, transportation network & transit delivery, & enhanced storing facilities into the warehouse, as well as the selling procedure, as an effort to precisely solve the technical elements of food safety concerns.This research stage aims to investigate food conditions and other numerous challenges experienced by transporters when selling fresh food by integrating the functioning of blockchain technology alongside the sensing processing of Internet of Things (IoT) devices with respect to the advancement of smart contracts, which are an example of the applications that blockchain offers to keep an eye on the record, as well as handling all stakeholder communications and transactions. All the transactions related to online technology can be verified with the use of IoT technology; whilst these activities are registered and subsequently stored into a centrally managed database structure. Faster food traceability is made possible using the advancement of Blockchain Technology, and this is anticipated for useful needs in complicated food supply chain management. These are some of the main significances of Blockchain technology to be adopted based on secured data processing of transactions.For transactions related to stakeholders, IoT thus makes an affordable and safe FSCM system possible for Quality Food preservation. Stakeholders will have fresh options for implementing a more effective food safety management system given that the methods adopted within the information technologies, like data storage within centralized warehouses, IOT based communication combined with data science enhancement, like data mining, pattern recognition, etc., throughout the entire food supply chain, including evaluating the systematic arrangement among the clients, retailers as well as the food business chains.

articleTitle: SMOTE-Enhanced Classification of Land Cover and Land use Patterns: A Comparative Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This study uses the Machine Learning Algorithms and satellite images to provide a thorough analysis of land use and land cover changes (LULC) in Ethiopia. Using Landsat imagery for classification, the study looks at the years 2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, and 2023. Data preparation, image processing, classification, and accuracy evaluation are all part of the methodology. The outcomes show how well the method works to find LULC, offering insightful information for environmental monitoring and land management. This research adds to the growing corpus of information on land cover dynamics in Ethiopia region by providing insightful information on the causes, patterns, and effects of land cover changes. By combining cutting-edge analytical methods with Landsat imagery , we can better comprehend the complex interactions between human activity and the environment, enabling stakeholders to make decisions that will support Ethiopia's natural resource conservation and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Multimodal Learning for Image Caption Generation: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In today's highly visual digital landscape, images have emerged as a common mode of communication across social media platforms. However, attaching meaningful and contextually relevant captions to these images remains a significant challenge. This paper presents an automated image caption generator designed to overcome these hurdles by leveraging the power of deep neural networks. The proposed approach employs a hybrid architecture that combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and recurrent neural networks with long short-term memory (LSTM) units. CNNs, specifically the VGG16 and ResNet-50 models, are utilized for their proficiency in extracting salient visual features from images. The Transformer architecture, widely used in natural language processing, is compared against these CNNs for its attention-based mechanisms and language modelling capabilities. LSTMs facilitate the generation of coherent and linguistically accurate textual descriptions. The system demonstrates an excellent performance across standard evaluation metrics like BLEU, METEOR and ROUGE on the Flickr8K dataset. Extensive experiments conducted on the Flickr8K dataset validate the efficacy of the system in capturing the essence of diverse images and producing relevant captions. The modular design and straightforward training methodology enable convenient deployment across various platforms and applications. This work introduces an adaptable framework poised to revolutionize visual storytelling by bridging the gap between imagery and text in our increasingly interconnected visual world. The automated image caption generator represents a significant stride towards enhancing communication and understanding through the seamless fusion of visual and linguistic modalities.

articleTitle: Enhancing Decision-Making in Small Retail : ML algorithms For Shop Owners
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research reflects on the role of Machine Learning (ML) in making small retail shop owners in India profitable, since they come up with inventory management problems, pricing issues and ways of engaging their customers thus getting better than their competitors. It discusses how, unlike all other apps in the market, "Ganak" is sharpened with a data-driven model and its applications by statistical analysis and ML algorithms. Through the utilization of big data technologies, Ganak intends to assist entrepreneurs who cannot afford the right inputs to improve their decision-making skills. This leads to an increased business efficiency and profitability. The paper has delivered on its objective, by producing findings that prove Ganak’s role in the decision making process, and adopting digital application that will thus lead to economic growth of small retailers in India.

articleTitle: Detection of Tuberculosis using Chest Xray and Hospital Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Tuberculosis (TB) remains an alarming worldwide health issue. Traditional tests for diagnosis, such as sputum smear microscopy and culture, have limited precision and accessibility, especially in resource-constrained areas. Chest X-rays (CXRs) offer a promising alternative for TB detection, providing a non-invasive and widely accessible means of assessing lung health. This research proposes a novel Tuberculosis Detection and Hospital Recommendation System utilizing CXR imaging and demographic variables, aiming to overcome the challenges associated with TB diagnosis and healthcare access. The Tuberculosis Detection portion of the system uses deep learning algorithms trained on a huge dataset of tagged CXR pictures and patient attributes. By leveraging artificial intelligence, this phase aims to predict the presence of TB with high accuracy, offering an automated and objective tool for TB detection. The integration of demographic variables enhances the predictive capability of the model, providing insights into the relationship between patient characteristics and disease status. Through the analysis of CXR images and demographic data, the system enables early and precise identification of TB cases, facilitating timely intervention and treatment initiation. Personalized hospital suggestions are prepared during the hospital recommendation phase, taking into account the patient's preferences, geography, and severity of condition. By considering factors such as proximity, hospital amenities, and patient preferences, the system empowers patients with informed choices while optimizing resource allocation within healthcare systems. This phase enhances patient autonomy and satisfaction by providing tailored recommendations aligned with individual needs and preferences. The comprehensive approach of the proposed system addresses the complexities of TB diagnosis and healthcare access, offering a data-driven solution for improving patient outcomes and public health. Through the utilization of deep learning algorithms, demographic data, and personalized recommendations, the system represents a significant advancement in TB management, contributing to the global efforts to overcome this deadly disease.

articleTitle: Scholarspot: Scholarship Recommendation System using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Scholarship applications continue to be difficult and time-consuming for students to complete. The current scholarship application processes are impersonal, which frequently causes mismatches between applicants' profiles and opportunities. Due to this inefficiency, deserving applicants miss out on opportunities, which adds to the problem of financial access to education as a whole. To simplify and improve the scholarship application process, this paper offers "ScholarSpot," a cutting-edge Scholarship Recommendation System. Scholar's Spot offers a personalized approach to scholarship suggestions by utilizing cutting-edge algorithms and data-driven insights. The technology generates customized suggestions based on user profiles, academic achievements, and personal goals, greatly accelerating the search for appropriate scholarships. The Scholar's Spot system uses cutting-edge algorithms and a user-centric approach to greatly enhance the matching of students with appropriate scholarships, resulting in saving a lot of time and effort of the students. With the help of different machine learning methods, for instance, SVM, DecisionTree, Random Forest, and content-based filtering, advertise its power and richness and enhance recommendations for customized scholarship. Despite a barely adequate accuracy score of 38%, similar to the one Support Vector Machine gave, Decision Tree algorithm outperformed the former, appearing to be at 72% accurate. Nevertheless, Random Forest was the algorithm that did so well and achieved a 78% correctness score, showing how effective it could have been in ensuring the accuracy of student-scholarship matching. Besides, choosing content-based filtration strategies provided an intelligent notice; thereby, the accuracy score was 94%, which shows that applying scholarship terms with applicant backgrounds can improve recommendation results. The findings are encouraging and show that the system can improve the scholarship application process and make it more suitable for students by tailoring the recommendations to their needs and providing a more precise information in accordance with what they are looking, contributing to their chances of acquiring a scholarship for their education.

articleTitle: Intelligent Integration of IoT and Cyber-Physical Systems: Empowering the Next Generation of AI-Enabled Smart Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: ObjectivesThis research aims to examine the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), focusing on their synergistic manifestations and transformative potential. It explores how AI enhances the capabilities of IoT devices and enables intelligent decision-making in CPS applications.MethodsThe study involves an in-depth analysis of the integration challenges such as data protection, scalability, and interoperability. It presents possible solutions like edge computing and secure communication protocols. Real-world examples and case studies are used to illustrate the practical benefits of AI-based optimizations.FindingsThe research demonstrates that AI technology significantly enhances resource allocation, predictive maintenance, and energy efficiency in IoT and CPS applications. It also addresses the integration challenges and provides solutions to improve system performance and security.NoveltyThis paper highlights future directions for the industry, emphasizing ethical aspects and the role of AI in enabling autonomous systems. It provides comprehensive guidance for researchers, practitioners, and decision-makers involved in technology-enabled environmental design, offering valuable insights into leveraging AI, IoT, and CPS integration.

articleTitle: Transparency in AI: A Review of Explainable Artificial Intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This article presents an overview of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) and its various methods, emphasizing the role of interpretability, in present day AI systems. With AI becoming more prevalent in decision making processes across fields there is a growing need for transparency and accountability. We delve into XAI techniques, such as agnostic methods like Local Interpretable Model agnostic Explanations (LIME) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) model specific approaches like Integrated Gradients and transparent models like decision trees and rule based systems. By examining the strengths and limitations of these methods we provide insights into their usefulness and effectiveness, in scenarios. This review aims to give researchers and practitioners a nuanced understanding of XAI to support the creation and implementation of transparent AI systems.

articleTitle: A Decentralized Document Storage Platform using IPFS with Enhanced Security
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In response to the evolving challenges of centralized file sharing and transport-layer issues in decentralized file systems, this research paper, "A Decentralized File Sharing using IPFS with Enhanced Security," delves into the potential of the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) made secure with Hybrid Encryption. This decentralized approach not only addresses issues of reliability and scalability but also prioritizes enhanced security measures. By integrating cutting-edge security protocols, our study aims to fortify the IPFS framework, creating a resilient platform for secure file sharing in the digital age using algorithms such as AES and ECC-based methods. Through this exploration, we contribute to the ongoing discourse on decentralized systems, offering insights into the future of efficient and secure digital information exchange.

articleTitle: Consent Based Electronic Health Record Sharing System
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Consent-based electronic health record sharing system is digital platform that helps patients to control the sharing of health records with healthcare providers. It system aims to improve the quality of healthcare delivery by enabling healthcare providers to access a patient's medical history and provide accurate diagnoses and treatment plans. The system also ensures that privacy is protected by obtaining consent before sharing health information. To create more transparent and decentralized system we are recording the transactions on a blockchain network. Blockchain technology ensures the authenticity and integrity of health data due to its immutability, making it significantly difficult for unauthorized parties to access or modify the data without the patient's consent.

articleTitle: Automated Medicinal Plant Identification through Image Processing and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research addresses the pressing challenge of accurately identifying medicinal plants in India's Ayurvedic Pharmaceutics, aiming to mitigate issues stemming from morphological variability and market adulteration. Traditional methods of plant identification are hindered by laborious processes and the potential for error, underscoring the need for an automated solution. Leveraging the power of advanced image processing and machine learning, our proposed software framework integrates the Xception model and early stopping fine-tuning to automate plant identification based on plant images. The methodology involves curating a comprehensive dataset of labelled plant images representing diverse medicinal plants, subsequently employing image preprocessing techniques to extract salient features like color, texture, and shape. The Xception model, renowned for its prowess in image recognition tasks, serves as the backbone architecture for both feature extraction and classification. To further optimize model performance and mitigate overfitting, early stopping fine-tuning techniques are applied. Through rigorous experimentation and validation, our research demonstrates the efficacy of this approach in accurately identifying medicinal plants, thereby fostering confidence and trust within the herbal medicine supply chain. By seamlessly integrating modern technological advancements with traditional botanical knowledge, our framework not only streamlines the identification process but also contributes to the sustainable utilization of herbal medicine resources. Ultimately, this research represents a pivotal step towards establishing a robust and reliable system for identifying medicinal plants, facilitating informed decision-making, and promoting the long-term viability of herbal medicine practices in India and beyond.

articleTitle: Adaptive Security in a Connected World: Review of Machine Learning for IoT Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In IoT Security risks are, however, presented to devices and services by this integration. To give machine learning (ML) credit for being a novel approach, this paper surveys Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) for the Traditional Network and Internet of Things. With 41 articles review, Machine Learning can adapt to the changing IoT environment, Deep Learning (DL) in particular shows promise as a method. IoT device with security problem with complex IoT landscape is too much for traditional rule-based IDS to handle, which has led to a rise in interest in machine learning approaches. To solve issues used different techniques are investigated. The research discusses important feature selection techniques related to IoT intrusion detection, emphasizing the value of feature engineering and classification. With newly created datasets both normal and malicious scenarios use performance measures such as F1-score, accuracy, precision, recall, and AUC-ROC.

articleTitle: Music Player System Using Real-Time Facial Expression Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In today's society, stress has become an escalating concern, aggravated by economic uncertainties and rising living costs. Listening to music is a widely recognized stress-relief strategy. The existing music player applications lack the sophistication to select songs tailored to the user's emotional state. This limitation restricts the therapeutic potential of music. Effective stress relief is closely tied to aligning the music with the user's current mood. To address this critical issue, we propose developing a groundbreaking Music Player System that leverages real-time facial expression detection to provide music recommendations. In this project, Python and Flask will be utilized to develop a user-friendly and responsive platform for the users. It uses the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm to provide real-time analysis of the user's facial expressions captured via a camera. This unique approach is intended to transform the music experience of the user by providing a dynamic playlist that is generated by processing the facial expressions of the user. Moreover, the system is designed to provide a smooth and personalized music experience, ensuring each song matches the user's emotions. This way, the system aims to relieve the stress of the user by providing emotion-based music recommendations.

articleTitle: Smart Detection of Passive Smokers using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Smoking is a destructive and addictive practice of inhaling burning plant material. It produces nicotine in the bloodstream that creates a negative impact on the bones, hormones, DNA, eyes, and the immune system. This has become the source of a great concern, especially amongst the young generation. Machine Learning is used to find a pattern of biological attributes to identify possible smokers. The process of teaching a machine to do intelligent classification from a sizable archive of historical data is known as machine learning. The aim of this paper is to develop a learning model that can detect passive smokers through features like eyesight, weight, fasting blood sugar, cholesterol and more. On this dataset, a number of data preprocessing operations are carried out to build a reliable model which include checking for null values , encoding the data , balancing the dataset and scaling it and selection of highly correlated features. A variety of supervised learning models are employed in the model training process to create a robust machine learning model. From the set of models applied, K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN) (84 %) and Random Forest (RF) (86 %) gave the highest accuracy. However, implementing Random Forest with Hyperparameter tuning using GridSearchCV resulted in a higher accuracy (87 %).

articleTitle: Exploring Community Detection Algorithms for Analyzing Dark Web Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The "dark web" is a term used to describe a network of websites not indexed by traditional search engines and can only be accessed through specific software, such as Tor (The Onion Router). The dark web has gained a reputation for hosting various activities, including illegal marketplaces, forums, and communication channels. In the context of the dark web, researchers have conducted studies to analyze its topology to understand its organization and characteristics of the dark web.This study proposes an approach for community detection in the dark web using a combination of graph theory and machine learning techniques. A graph representation of the dark web is constructed using data collected from Tor dark web. Three popular community detection algorithms, namely Leiden, Louvain, and Label Propagation, are applied to crawled dark web data. The evaluation of these algorithms on a dataset of the dark web demonstrated its effectiveness in identifying meaningful communities. The results obtained from these approaches can provide valuable insights into the organization and structure of the dark web, which can benefit law enforcement agencies and cybersecurity researchers in their efforts to comprehend activities on the dark web.

articleTitle: The Influence of Technophilia, Social Media Marketing and EV Infrastructure on the Continuing Adoption of Electric Vehicles in Malaysia via Technology Continuance Theory (TCT) Lens: Cognitive Interview Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper explores the factors influencing the continued adoption of Electric Vehicles (EVs) in Malaysia, employing the Technology Continuance Theory (TCT) as a conceptual framework. Through a Pre-Test phase utilizing Cognitive Interview-based analysis, feedback from 7 participants is leveraged to refine the questionnaire for the pilot study. Currently ongoing, the pilot study aims to collect data to scrutinize the factors impacting EV adoption in Malaysia. The research will further expound on the TCT framework within the paper and utilize insights from the interviews to refine the questionnaire for the pilot study. The findings are expected to contribute to a deeper understanding of EV continuance adoption and offer practical strategies for sustainable transportation in Malaysia.

articleTitle: Monitoring Worker Safety and Health in Coal Mine
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This system aims to improve the safety and health of coal mine workers by implementing a comprehensive interactive monitoring system. The main goal is to minimize job hazards and reduce risks associated with the coal mining industry. A variety of methods were used in the research, including technology development, data analysis and quality control methods. The project begins with the development and application of advanced technology to monitor critical environmental problems in coal mines. Sensors collect real-time data about air quality, temperature, humidity and gas concentration. Miners are also given wearable devices equipped with biometric sensors to monitor their physical parameters, including heart rate and breathing patterns. The collected data is then processed using analytical tools to identify patterns, trends and anomalies. Use machine learning algorithms to predict potential safety hazards and immediately alert staff and management. This predictive analysis helps detect adverse events early, allowing timely intervention and preventing accidents or health problems. We will be able to conduct regular safety training, using information from our monitoring process to tailor training content to address specific risks identified at the mine. The results of using this analysis will show the reduction in security incidents, conditions and functional diseases. A good approach to safety management improves the overall health of workers, thereby increasing mines’ productivity and morale. Hence, this project demonstrates the effectiveness of comprehensive care in terms of worker health and safety. Thus, the system will help create a safe and healthy working environment, ultimately benefiting employment and overall productivity in the mining industry.

articleTitle: The Future of Emotional Engineering: Integrating Generative AI and Emotional Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper investigates the emerging field of emotional engineering which takes the form of a marriage between generative artificial intelligence (AI) and emotional intelligence that is set to redefine the future of human-machine collaboration. With the latest advances in AI having allowed for broad understanding and generation of human-like emotional responses, this paper illuminates the frameworks for creating systems that are capable of empathizing with and responding to the emotions of human users that can be widely applied across domains such as healthcare and customer service. The findings here indicate that user experiences can be drastically improved through applications such as those which allow for machines to accompany emotional intelligence, as they can enable more empathetic interactions. Emotion AI isn’t about having "feelings" in the human sense — it’s more about accurate and relevant emotional interaction. There’s no doubt "emotional engineering" will spawn gadgets that are truly empathetic and not just intelligent, but it also raises large questions about what happens now that we must account for emotions in our digital interactions.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence for Detecting Cyber Attacks in Deepfake & Identity Theft
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In today's era of digital world and evolving cyber threats, this research paper presents a unified exploration of innovative techniques harnessing the power of artificial intelligence and blockchain to combat deepfake attacks and identity theft. These intertwined challenges demand holistic solutions that transcend traditional boundaries. As the digital landscape is increasingly infiltrated by deepfake technology, concerns surrounding the authenticity of digital content are reaching a critical juncture. Deepfake attacks, capable of generating persuasive yet false imagery and videos, pose a grave societal threat. They undermine trust in media, perpetuate misinformation, and raise the specter of identity theft. Image processing techniques for deepfake detection aim to distinguish real from manipulated content by leveraging advances in AI. Meanwhile, the application of AI and machine learning in deepfake detection has yielded promising results, enhancing our capacity to discern authentic media from forgeries. The research converges on a proactive approach, introducing a pioneering framework that integrates AI and blockchain technology. This paper proposes an Artificial Intelligence-based protection framework, leveraging unsupervised pre-training techniques and Dense Neural Networks (DNN), to combat identity impersonation attacks, particularly the Clone ID attack directed at the Routing Protocol for Low Power and Lossy Networks (RPL). The research investigates the potential of blockchain, including Smart Contracts to combat the deepfake problem by verifying digital media's history and provenance.

articleTitle: Credit Risk Analysis using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Machine learning techniques and Python programming can be transformed to solve the shortcomings of traditional systems that rely a lot on historical data for credit risk assessments. An essential component of financial decision-making is credit risk analysis, which evaluates borrowers’ creditworthiness on the basis of variables like income, credit history, and loan terms. This creative strategy improves accuracy and scalability by utilizing data driven methodologies, automation, and Python’s flexible modules such as scikit-learn, NumPy, and Pandas. It also integrates cutting-edge data analytics and technologies like blockchain for safe data exchange, and expands its capacity to include data from unusual sources like social media and geographic data. Real-time credit risk assessments and flexibility in response to changing borrower behavior are made possible by these developments. The dedication to openness and adherence to the law highlights the significance of lending responsibly. This study makes a contribution by showcasing the important developments in credit risk analysis made possible by Python and machine learning. These technologies provide a flexible and adaptive method of evaluating credit risk, which promotes economic stability in the constantly changing financial environment.

articleTitle: Unlocking the Agricultural Potential: Exploring AI’s Role in Mitigating Risks of Pests and Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research article investigates a friendly computer assistant intended to make farming easier. The weather can be unpredictable, and there are additional issues that make farming difficult. Thus, we used artificial intelligence (AI) to construct a unique computer software. This program assists farmers with many activities around the farm, acting as a smart assistant. Our primary goal is to ensure that this technology is easy for farmers to use. We want it to be as helpful as a farm friend. This tool does cool things like monitor crops, identify potential concerns, and even perform some tasks automatically. It’s like having another set of eyes and hands on the farm. In this study, we will discuss the development process, capabilities, and potential applications of this program for farmers. We want to ensure that this technology is useful and something that actual farmers can utilize, not just something flashy. We want to aid farmers all across the world and increase farming’s efficiency by doing this.

articleTitle: Optimization Techniques in Reinforcement Learning for Healthcare: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: One paradigm for machine learning that is transforming is reinforcement learning, or RL, promising significant healthcare improvements through personalized treatment recommendations, optimized resource allocation, and enhanced predictive modeling. Despite these successes, challenges such as model interpretability and real-world integration persist. This paper reviews various optimization techniques employed in RL, focusing on Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) due to its stability, efficiency, and applicability in healthcare. Applications of PPO include adaptive treatment strategies, personalized medication management, and optimized clinical workflows. Additionally, the paper discusses case studies demonstrating RL’s potential to reduce medication errors, enhance treatment protocols, predict adverse events, and personalize radiation therapy. A comprehensive database search initially retrieved 708 articles; after removing duplicates and screening based on titles and abstracts, 23 articles were considered, ultimately narrowing down to 15 articles following the application of exclusion criteria. The findings demonstrate RL’s significant impact on healthcare, enhancing treatment effectiveness, optimizing service selection, and improving patient care through advanced techniques like Deep RL and multi-agent systems. Future research should focus on developing sophisticated adaptive treatment models and validating RL applications through clinical trials, underscoring RL’s potential to revolutionize healthcare by making it more effective, efficient, and patient centric.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Heart Disease Prediction: Harnessing Machine Learning for Proactive Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Advancement of IoT (Internet of Things) technology presents promising opportunities in healthcare, particularly in addressing the challenges of early detection and prognosis of Cardiovascular Diseases (CVD). This research findings introduce a new strategy which integrates sensors, machine learning algorithms, and IoT technologies to enhance diagnostic capabilities and prognostic accuracy. Leveraging temperature, pulse, and ECG sensors, alongside ML techniques, patient data is gathered and kept in the Thing Speak platform. The ECG sensor observes cardiac electrical activity, while the pulse sensor measures heart rate, offering crucial information about cardiovascular well-being. Machine learning models, trained on the UCI Repository dataset, encompassing various algorithms like LR (logistic regression), RF (random forests), KNN (K Nearest Neighbors), and SVM (Support Vector Machines), DT (Decision Tree used to distinguish symptoms indicative of cardiovascular diseases. Performance measures such as F-score, precision, recall, and accuracy evaluate the efficacy of these classifiers. By enabling early detection and prognostication, this comprehensive approach aims to facilitate timely intervention and ultimately enhance patient outcomes in cardiovascular health care.

articleTitle: Improving Cervical Cancer Detection Through Machine and Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Cervical cancer, a prominent contributor to mortality in low-income countries, can often be effectively treated if detected early through the removal of affected tissues. Automating the identification of pre-cancerous cervical lesions using image-based methods represents a critical advancement, revolutionizing the detection of cervical pre-cancerous features. In recent years, the interest of researchers in the fields of computer vision and machine learning has been drawn to the development of computer-aided diagnostic systems for processing digital colposcopies. This has led to a multitude of challenges and computational solutions. In this study, we employ various algorithms, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Faster R-CNN, Region-based Convolutional Neural Networks (R-CNN), Random Forest, and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Support Vector Machines (SVM), for automated colposcopy-based detection of pre-cancerous lesions. Additionally, we contribute to ongoing efforts aimed at improving early detection and treatment of cervical cancer, particularly in resource-limited settings, by utilizing a mathematical model-based classification method to extract features used in identifying pre-cancerous characteristics.

articleTitle: SecureBid: Empowering Fair and Transparent Tendering through Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: There is lack of lacunas in the traditional tender allocation process like lack of transparency, inefficiency, paperwork, limited use of technology, etc. are highly prone to error. The rise of blockchain technology has paved the way for innovative applications in a variety of industries. The fairness, openness, and security of traditional government tender distribution procedures have long been problematic, compromising the integrity of decision-making. The tendering environment has become less trustworthy due to biased judgments, excessive paperwork, and data security concerns. In order to transform existing procedures, "SecureBid," a blockchain-based system, is presented in this article. SecureBid tackles these issues by utilizing the immutability and decentralization that are intrinsic to blockchain technology. The system increases efficiency, strengthens security, lowers corruption, and promotes transparency by leveraging Ethereum, React JS, and Solidity. This article describes the drawbacks of the conventional approach and shows how SecureBid offers an unchangeable and transparent record of transactions related to tenders, making it a strong alternative.

articleTitle: Review of Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Deep Learning falls within the realm of artificial intelligence as a subset of Machine Learning. It plays a crucial role in our everyday lives. The field of Deep learning has expanded significantly in recent years and finds application in wide array of contexts. Deep learning (DL) has made its impact in many areas predictive forecasting, voice generation and recognition, audio, video, image generation and recognition, multimedia, computer vision and language processing etc. Deep Learning primarily employs artificial neural network (ANN) to identify patterns and acquire decision making capabilities from them. These neural networks are designed to emulate the functionality of human brain, which possesses a deep architecture. Deep Learning excels in its capacity to learn from extensive datasets. Deep Learning employs Deep Learning Neural Networks (DNN) comprising multiple layers of units with optimized algorithms and architectures. This paper focuses on many generally used deep learning optimization methods in order to enhance accuracy. Additionally, deep convolution networks (CNN), Artificial Neural Networks, Supervised or Discriminative Learning, Feed-forward Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Backpropagation, convolutional neural networks, Autoencoders, LSTM, and generative advertisement networks (GAN) are encompassed in the review.

articleTitle: SVM-based Sarcasm Detection System: NLP Using Heuristic Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: To create a system that will detect and interpret sarcastic messages in blog and tweet using natural language processing (NLP) technology and support vector machines (SVM). The data used for training and evaluation are available on global blog profiles, making it useful for capturing the nuances of informal conversations. Using NLP, the system understands the context and speech patterns that indicate malicious language, allowing for more accurate detection. Using SVM as a classification technique helps build a robust and reliable model of sarcasm by enabling the system to discern between tweets that are sarcastic and those that aren't. With sarcasm increasingly used in online communication, developing this technique can help improve thinking and understanding of tone and meaning on social media. In the age of thinking, different analytics have emerged that analyze people's behavior and thoughts on social media (such as Facebook, Twitter, blogs and other social networking sites). The main purpose of sentiment analysis is to identify the text's polarity—positive, negative, or neutral.

articleTitle: Exploring Investor Sentiment and Nifty 50 Volatility: A Behavioural Finance Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This research paper explores a thorough behavioral finance approach to examine the complex relationship between investor sentiment and volatility in the Nifty 50 index. Though behavioral finance offers insights into how psychological biases and sentiment-driven trading behaviors can affect market dynamics, traditional financial theories frequently presume that investors are rational and that markets are efficient. This paper studies how investor sentiment affects the volatility of the Nifty 50 index by exploring quantitative analysis and case studies of research literature. The findings will provide critical information for investors, market players, and policymakers. The research study also provides a comprehensive overview of the necessary research methodologies and instruments for stock analysis.

articleTitle: Soil Health Analysis Using Few-Shot Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative approach to soil health analysis specifically tailored for farmers in a Pune division. We addressing the unique agricultural needs of this region by leveraging advanced machine learning techniques and data-driven methodologies. Our research focused on the development of machine learning models for crop recommendation and soil classification, utilizing diverse datasets including soil nutrient information, soil card details, weather records, and soil image visuals. The first aspect of our investigation involves the implementation of a few-shot learning model for personalized crop suggestions. This model considering the unique characteristics of the soil in the Pune division, incorporating data from soil card filings, weather reports, and soil images specific to the region. By providing tailor recommendations for optimal crop selection, our model aiming to maximize agricultural productivity and sustainability for Pune division farmers. In the second phase, we employing convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for soil picture classification. This model analyzing soil visuals to accurately categorize soil types, assisting in soil classification procedures crucial for various agricultural and environmental applications within the Pune division. Our emphasis throughout this research is on developing robust and accurate machine learning models that cater to the agricultural needs of Pune division farmers. By combining cutting-edge machine learning techniques with region-specific agricultural data, including soil image data, this research aims to empower Pune division farmers with actionable insights. Our goal is to promote sustainable farming practices and contribute to the agricultural development of the region.

articleTitle: Advancing Energy Sustainability with Artificial Intelligence in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: Power systems are changing as a result of the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) technology. These innovations address issues with renewable energy integration, evolving consumption patterns, and the requirement for increased system dependability and efficiency. This thorough research examines the function and effects of artificial intelligence (AI) in power systems, examining case studies and the body of existing literature to clarify the uses, advantages, difficulties, and potential paths for AI adoption. Through an analysis of AI-powered solutions in power generation, transmission, distribution, and control, this study provides policymakers, utilities, academics, and industry participants with knowledge about how AI may be used to tackle urgent energy issues and enable sustainable energy transitions.

articleTitle: Leveraging Metaheuristic Algorithms for Optimal Feature Selection in IoT Cybersecurity: A Study on Enhancing DDoS Attack Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the realm of interconnected devices, such as Internet of Things (IoT) networks, vulnerabilities can often lead to the manifestation of Denial of Service (DoS) and Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, thereby posing significant challenges to the robustness and reliability of these systems. These attacks engage the server or multiple components of the network with flooded traffic which is mostly artificially generated. This does not allow for user requests to be responded to by the server, hence reducing the performance of the network. Metaheuristic algorithms have emerged as crucial tools in addressing optimization problems, with many of these approaches drawing inspiration from the collective intelligence and foraging behaviors exhibited by natural organisms, thereby providing novel and effective strategies for identifying optimal solutions. This paper introduces a nature inspired metaheuristic Salp Swarm Algorithm (SSA), inspired by the collaborative foraging and navigation behaviours of Salps. Accuracies are validated by various classifiers like CNN, RNN, DNN. Using metaheuristic algorithms like SSA for optimal feature selection and deep learning classifiers to classify over which protocol the attacks are taking place, we are able to predict which type of attack (DDos or DoS) takes place given the important features shortlisted using the feature selection algorithm. RNN gives better accuracy of 100% on BoT-IoT datasets.

articleTitle: The Future of Content Creation: Leveraging AI for Code, Text, Music, and Video Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In the dynamic realm of artificial intelligence (AI), the demand for versatile and accessible AI-powered tools is burgeoning. This project introduces a pioneering AI-driven multi-modal content generation platform, aimed at empowering users with the transformative potential of AI through a user-friendly, one-click interface. Harnessing cutting-edge advancements in machine learning and neural networks, our platform offers a diverse array of content generation capabilities encompassing code, text, music, video, and beyond. This innovative system leverages state-of-the-art AI algorithms meticulously curated to furnish users with efficient and intuitive content creation tools spanning various domains. With a single click, users can effortlessly generate top-tier code snippets, craft coherent and context-sensitive text, compose captivating music, and even fashion compelling videos, thus expanding the horizons of creativity and productivity.Our project not only democratizes the potential of AI, placing it within easy reach of users but also delves into the synergistic interplay between different AI modalities, facilitating the creation of multi-dimensional content. Through an intuitive interface, our platform seamlessly amalgamates these AI capabilities, rendering them accessible to a diverse spectrum of individuals, from programmers and writers to musicians and video producers.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of User Experience Research on Somatosensory Games for Older Adults
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In light of the global aging population, there is an increasing recognition of the urgent need to investigate the satisfaction levels of the elderly concerning their physical well-being and sociocultural entertainment needs. Sensor-based gaming has gained widespread acclaim among elderly players for its potential to enhance both physical health and psychological well-being. However, the factors influencing the accessibility and enthusiasm of elderly individuals to engage in sensor-based gaming, as well as the extent of scholarly research in this area, remain unclear. This study utilized the PRISMA methodology to systematically gather 36 English-language scholarly sources from three major databases—Web of Science, Scopus, and IEEE Xplore—covering the years 2019 to 2023. The goal was to critically synthesize and evaluate existing empirical research findings while conducting a comprehensive review of achievements, limitations, drawbacks, and future challenges and opportunities within the current literature on user experiences in elderly sports gaming. The findings indicate that factors such as the physical activity and cognitive capabilities of the elderly, game incentive mechanisms, cooperative-competitive modes, personalized feature design, group participation, and gaming frequency are pivotal determinants of the successful engagement of elderly individuals in sensor-based gaming. The results of this study provide crucial and well-supported insights for using sensor-based gaming to address the challenges of an aging population. These insights will help researchers and policymakers delve deeper into existing challenges to enhance the satisfaction of elderly individuals regarding both physical and psychological well-being.

articleTitle: Introducing Interactive Elements To Mobile Virtual Reality: Leveraging Smartphone Sensors For Immersive Experiences
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: In today’s dynamic landscape of augmented and virtual reality (AR/VR), the quest for inclusive and interactive experiences has become paramount. Traditional interactive VR systems are often costly and inaccessible to many users. In response, this research endeavors to democratize immersive experiences by leveraging everyday smartphones with basic VR headsets. By harnessing smartphone sensors and integrating image tracking technology, our research aims to bridge the gap between costly interactive VR systems and accessible passive VR experiences. The implementation involves methodologies such as image tracking using Vuforia, masking of the real world, gyroscopic control for 360-degree viewing, and split-screen VR rendering for stereoscopic viewing. Additionally, the paper discusses the challenges encountered, including the integration of hand tracking technology and the optimization of performance for mobile deployment. Through iterative development and exploration of methodologies, our research seeks to advance the field of smartphone-integrated passive VR, making immersive experiences accessible to a broader audience across various domains.

articleTitle: Maternal Risk Factors and Infant Sleep Difficulties: A Multivariate Regression Analysis and Comprehensive Review of Empirical Studies
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: The inability to get an infant to sleep can be a major stressor for everyone involved since it can affect the family's health and development. Understanding the impact of maternal characteristics, especially those considered "at risk," is crucial for creating successful interventions. The paper employs multivariate regression analysis to examine the correlation between maternal risk factors and baby sleep problems. Compile empirical study results and utilize literature evaluations to comprehend the complex interaction between maternal features and infant sleep patterns... These findings stress the need to consider a wide range of variables when trying to forecast when a baby will sleep, including the mother's socioeconomic position, her mental health, the stress she experiences as a parent, and the bond between her and her child. To guide future studies, review several methodological approaches and point out where the literature is lacking. Researchers, physicians, and legislators aiming to promote good baby sleep health in vulnerable populations can ultimately benefit from the insights provided by this analysis.

articleTitle: "AffectAlchemy": An Affective Dataset Based on Plutchik’s Psychological Model for Text-Based Emotion Recognition and its Analysis Using ML Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Computing, Communication, Control and Automation (ICCUBEA)
abstract: A technique to identify people's attitudes, and sentiments towards specified targets such as things, services, and subjects, is called sentiment analysis. As a dedicated subset of NLP, it deals with predicting specific reactions broadly characterizing sentiments as positive, negative, or neutral. However, the accuracy and depth vary since there are a variety of human emotions that exist rather than just positive, negative, and neutral. In the past few decades, the term affective computing has become well-liked which involves the use of AI for identifying, interpreting, and responding to human emotions. A part of it called text-based affective systems are artificial emotional intelligent systems that often categorize the text into core wide range of emotions like fear, sadness, anger, and happiness. These affective systems use various psychological models for emotion recognition. Our study incorporates the development of a dataset based on Robert Plutchik's psychological model of emotions, which sets forth eight primary emotions which are combined to form more complex emotions, resulting in a total of 24 secondary emotions resulting total of 32 variety of emotions. The work introduces the "AffectAlchemy" dataset which is validated using multiclass classification machine learning techniques. This dataset can contribute to the field of affective computing for the development of models that can do enhanced emotion recognition, and improved emotional context understanding to develop emotion-aware applications and facilitating research in affective systems.
